records.questionZh: 你一天中什麼時候喝咖啡？
records.questionEn: When during the day do you drink coffee?
records.answerZh: 我每天早上都喝一杯咖啡。沒喝的話，上班會很想睡覺。
records.answerEn: I drink a cup of coffee every morning. If I don't, I get really sleepy at work.

records.questionZh: 你週末什麼時候最常出去玩？
records.questionEn: When do you usually go out on the weekend?
records.answerZh: 我週末下午最常出去走走。早上我都在家睡覺。
records.answerEn: I usually go out in the afternoon on weekends. In the morning I sleep in at home.

records.questionZh: 你中午都跟誰一起吃東西？
records.questionEn: Who do you usually eat with at noon?
records.answerZh: 我中午常常跟同事一起吃飯。我們都去公司附近的便當店。
records.answerEn: I often eat with my coworkers at lunchtime. We always go to the bento shop near the office.

records.questionZh: 你來台灣以後，交到新朋友了嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you made new friends since coming to Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我在華語課認識了很多新朋友。他們來自不同的國家。
records.answerEn: I've met a lot of new friends in my Mandarin class. They come from different countries.

records.questionZh: 你現在在學什麼語言？學多久了？
records.questionEn: What language are you learning now? How long have you been learning it?
records.answerZh: 我現在在學華語，學了快一年了。我覺得聲調最難。
records.answerEn: I'm learning Mandarin now, almost a year already. I think the tones are the hardest.

records.questionZh: 你住的地方有很多從別的國家來的人嗎？
records.questionEn: Are there many people from other countries where you live?
records.answerZh: 我住的地方有很多外國人。附近的老闆都會說一點英文。
records.answerEn: There are lots of foreigners where I live. The shop owners nearby all speak a little English.

records.questionZh: 你現在在什麼地方工作？
records.questionEn: Where are you working now?
records.answerZh: 我在一家小公司工作。公司就在捷運站旁邊，很方便。
records.answerEn: I work at a small company. The office is right next to the MRT station, so it's very convenient.

records.questionZh: 你住的地方大不大？可以介紹一下嗎？
records.questionEn: Is your place big? Can you describe it a little?
records.answerZh: 我的房間不大，可是很乾淨。窗戶外面可以看到山。
records.answerEn: My room isn't big, but it's very clean. I can see the mountains outside the window.

records.questionZh: 你家附近有什麼商店？
records.questionEn: What shops are near your home?
records.answerZh: 我家前面就有一家便利商店。晚上肚子餓的時候很方便。
records.answerEn: There's a convenience store right in front of my home. It's very handy when I get hungry at night.

records.questionZh: 你睡覺的時候，手機放在哪裡？
records.questionEn: Where do you put your phone when you sleep?
records.answerZh: 我睡覺的時候把手機放在枕頭下面。我知道這樣不好，可是習慣了。
records.answerEn: When I sleep, I put my phone under my pillow. I know it's not good, but I'm used to it.

records.questionZh: 你們公司附近哪裡可以買咖啡？
records.questionEn: Where can you buy coffee near your office?
records.answerZh: 出了捷運站往前走，右邊就有一家咖啡店。那裡的拿鐵很好喝。
records.answerEn: When you leave the MRT station and walk ahead, there's a coffee shop on the right. Their lattes are really good.

records.questionZh: 你家附近有什麼好吃的店？
records.questionEn: Are there any good places to eat near your home?
records.answerZh: 我家對面有一家很好吃的麵店。我常常下班以後去那裡吃晚餐。
records.answerEn: There's a really good noodle shop across from my home. I often go there for dinner after work.

records.questionZh: 你每天花多少時間坐車上班？
records.questionEn: How much time do you spend commuting to work every day?
records.answerZh: 我每天坐捷運上班要一個鐘頭。我都在車上聽音樂。
records.answerEn: It takes me an hour to get to work by MRT every day. I always listen to music on the train.

records.questionZh: 星期六、星期天你通常做什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you usually do on Saturdays and Sundays?
records.answerZh: 我週末通常會去爬山或是逛夜市。如果下雨就在家看電影。
records.answerEn: On weekends I usually go hiking or visit a night market. If it rains, I watch movies at home.

records.questionZh: 你這幾天有什麼計畫嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you have any plans for the next few days?
records.answerZh: 後天我要跟朋友去台中玩。我們打算坐高鐵去。
records.answerEn: The day after tomorrow I'm going to Taichung with friends. We plan to take the high-speed rail.

records.questionZh: 你是幾月幾號出生的？那天你會做什麼？
records.questionEn: What date were you born? What do you do on that day?
records.answerZh: 我的生日是七月十號。那天我會請朋友一起去吃火鍋。
records.answerEn: My birthday is July 10th. On that day I treat my friends to hot pot.

records.questionZh: 你來這裡之前在做什麼？
records.questionEn: What were you doing before you came here?
records.answerZh: 我剛才在便利商店買東西。我買了一個便當當午餐。
records.answerEn: Just now I was buying things at a convenience store. I bought a bento for lunch.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣最喜歡喝什麼飲料？
records.questionEn: What's your favorite drink in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我最喜歡喝珍珠奶茶。我每次都點半糖少冰，不會太甜。
records.answerEn: I like bubble milk tea the most. I always order it half sugar, light ice, so it's not too sweet.

records.questionZh: 你喜歡吃什麼肉？
records.questionEn: What kind of meat do you like to eat?
records.answerZh: 我最喜歡吃牛肉。我常常去吃牛肉麵，又熱又好吃。
records.answerEn: I like beef the most. I often go eat beef noodle soup; it's hot and delicious.

records.questionZh: 你喜歡吃香蕉和西瓜嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you like eating bananas and watermelon?
records.answerZh: 我很喜歡吃水果，尤其是西瓜。台灣的水果又便宜又甜。
records.answerEn: I really like fruit, especially watermelon. Fruit in Taiwan is cheap and sweet.

records.questionZh: 你早上都吃什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you usually eat in the morning?
records.answerZh: 我早上常常吃麵包，配一杯咖啡。家附近的麵包店很好吃。
records.answerEn: I often have bread in the morning with a cup of coffee. The bakery near my home is really good.

records.questionZh: 你每天起床以後都會先吃東西嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you always eat something first after you get up?
records.answerZh: 對，我每天都一定要吃早餐。不吃的話，上班的時候會沒有精神。
records.answerEn: Yes, I have to eat breakfast every day. If I don't, I have no energy at work.

records.questionZh: 你今天起床以後吃東西了嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you eaten anything since you got up today?
records.answerZh: 我今天起得太晚，沒時間吃早飯。我等一下要去買個飯糰。
records.answerEn: I got up too late today and didn't have time for breakfast. I'm going to buy a rice ball in a bit.

records.questionZh: 你去買飲料的時候會自己帶東西裝嗎？
records.questionEn: When you buy a drink, do you bring something of your own to put it in?
records.answerZh: 我都會帶自己的杯子去買飲料。有的店還可以便宜五塊錢。
records.answerEn: I always bring my own cup when I buy drinks. Some shops even give you five dollars off.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣的小吃怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: What do you think of Taiwanese street food?
records.answerZh: 我覺得台灣的小吃都很好吃。我最喜歡蚵仔煎和滷肉飯。
records.answerEn: I think Taiwanese street food is all really tasty. My favorites are oyster omelet and braised pork rice.

records.questionZh: 你晚上通常幾點上床？
records.questionEn: What time do you usually go to bed at night?
records.answerZh: 我通常十二點左右睡覺。睡前我常常滑手機，所以睡得有點晚。
records.answerEn: I usually go to sleep around midnight. I often scroll on my phone before bed, so I sleep a bit late.

records.questionZh: 你剛來台灣的時候，誰對你最好？
records.questionEn: When you first came to Taiwan, who was the nicest to you?
records.answerZh: 我的房東很熱心，常常來幫忙。她還帶我去辦健保卡。
records.answerEn: My landlady was really warm-hearted and often came to help. She even took me to get my health insurance card.

records.questionZh: 你對台灣的天氣有什麼看法？
records.questionEn: What's your view of Taiwan's weather?
records.answerZh: 我覺得台灣的夏天太熱了。可是冬天很舒服，不會下雪。
records.answerEn: I think summer in Taiwan is too hot. But winter is comfortable, and it doesn't snow.

records.questionZh: 你跟朋友出去的時候，喜歡做什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you like to do when you go out with friends?
records.answerZh: 我很喜歡跟朋友去唱歌。我們常常一唱就唱到半夜。
records.answerEn: I love going singing with friends. Once we start, we often sing until midnight.

records.questionZh: 你今天的華語課幾點結束？
records.questionEn: What time does your Mandarin class end today?
records.answerZh: 我今天十二點下課。下課以後我要跟同學去吃午餐。
records.answerEn: I finish class at twelve today. After class I'm going to have lunch with my classmates.

records.questionZh: 有人敲你的門，你會說什麼？
records.questionEn: If someone knocks on your door, what do you say?
records.answerZh: 我會說「請進來」。如果是不認識的人，我會先問是誰。
records.answerEn: I say "Please come in." If it's someone I don't know, I ask who it is first.

records.questionZh: 你今天晚上幾點會到家？
records.questionEn: What time will you get home tonight?
records.answerZh: 我今天大概九點才會回來。你們先吃飯，不用等我。
records.answerEn: I probably won't be back until nine tonight. You all go ahead and eat; don't wait for me.

records.questionZh: 你常常跟朋友出去嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you often go out with friends?
records.answerZh: 我跟朋友差不多每個星期見面一次。我們通常約在捷運站。
records.answerEn: I meet up with my friends about once a week. We usually meet at the MRT station.

records.questionZh: 你放假的時候喜歡做什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you like to do when you have time off?
records.answerZh: 我放假的時候很喜歡去旅行。上次我去了花蓮，風景很漂亮。
records.answerEn: I love to travel when I have time off. Last time I went to Hualien, and the scenery was beautiful.

records.questionZh: 你搬家的時候，要買哪些東西？
records.questionEn: When you move, what things do you have to buy?
records.answerZh: 我搬家的時候需要買很多東西。像是床、桌子和電風扇。
records.answerEn: When I move, I need to buy lots of things, like a bed, a table, and an electric fan.

records.questionZh: 你什麼時候來台灣學中文的？
records.questionEn: When did you come to Taiwan to study Chinese?
records.answerZh: 我去年九月開始學華語。一開始覺得很難，現在好多了。
records.answerEn: I started learning Mandarin last September. At first I found it hard, but now it's much better.

records.questionZh: 如果朋友來你家，你會跟他說什麼？
records.questionEn: If a friend comes to your home, what do you say to them?
records.answerZh: 我會先說「歡迎你來！」然後泡一杯茶請他喝。
records.answerEn: First I say "Welcome!" Then I make a cup of tea for them.

records.questionZh: 你在夜市買東西怎麼結帳？
records.questionEn: How do you pay when you buy things at a night market?
records.answerZh: 在夜市我都用現金付錢。很多小攤子不能刷卡。
records.answerEn: At night markets I always pay with cash. A lot of the little stalls don't take cards.

records.questionZh: 你家裡誰最會做菜？
records.questionEn: Who in your family is the best cook?
records.answerZh: 我奶奶最會做菜。她煮的雞湯比餐廳的還好喝。
records.answerEn: My grandma is the best cook. Her chicken soup is even better than a restaurant's.

records.questionZh: 你常去的早餐店，老闆是什麼樣的人？
records.questionEn: What is the owner of your usual breakfast shop like?
records.answerZh: 早餐店的阿姨人很好。她都記得我要點什麼。
records.answerEn: The auntie at the breakfast shop is really nice. She always remembers what I order.

records.questionZh: 你有小孩嗎？是男生還是女生？
records.questionEn: Do you have kids? Boy or girl?
records.answerZh: 我有一個女兒，今年五歲。她很喜歡畫畫和唱歌。
records.answerEn: I have a daughter who is five this year. She loves drawing and singing.

records.questionZh: 你們班上的同學多嗎？
records.questionEn: Are there many students in your class?
records.answerZh: 我們班有十個人，男生只有三個。大部分都是女生。
records.answerEn: There are ten people in our class, and only three are guys. Most are girls.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣的公園怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: What do you think of the parks in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 台灣的公園有很多小孩在玩。晚上也常看到阿公阿嬤在散步。
records.answerEn: There are lots of kids playing in Taiwan's parks. In the evening you often see grandpas and grandmas taking walks too.

records.questionZh: 你以後想住在什麼樣的地方？
records.questionEn: What kind of place do you want to live in in the future?
records.answerZh: 我以後想買一間有院子的房子。可是台北的房子太貴了。
records.answerEn: In the future I want to buy a house with a yard. But houses in Taipei are too expensive.

records.questionZh: 你生病的時候會去哪裡看醫生？
records.questionEn: Where do you go to see a doctor when you're sick?
records.answerZh: 小感冒我會去診所。如果很嚴重，我才會去大醫院。
records.answerEn: For a small cold I go to a clinic. Only if it's serious do I go to a big hospital.

records.questionZh: 你在家工作的時候，坐得舒服嗎？
records.questionEn: When you work from home, are you comfortable sitting?
records.answerZh: 我家的椅子太硬了，坐久了腰會痛。我想買一張新的。
records.answerEn: The chair at home is too hard; my back hurts if I sit too long. I want to buy a new one.

records.questionZh: 你上班的時候都穿什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you usually wear to work?
records.answerZh: 我上班都穿襯衫和黑色的褲子。夏天太熱的時候會換短一點的。
records.answerEn: I wear a shirt and black pants to work. When summer gets too hot, I switch to shorter ones.

records.questionZh: 你出門的時候，東西都放在哪裡？
records.questionEn: When you go out, where do you put your things?
records.answerZh: 我出門一定會帶一個包包。裡面有錢包、雨傘和行動電源。
records.answerEn: I always take a bag when I go out. Inside there's my wallet, an umbrella, and a power bank.

records.questionZh: 你每天看手機很久，身體會不舒服嗎？
records.questionEn: You look at your phone a lot every day. Does your body feel uncomfortable?
records.answerZh: 我每天看手機太久，眼睛常常很累。所以我晚上盡量不看螢幕。
records.answerEn: I look at my phone too long every day, so my eyes are often tired. So at night I try not to look at screens.

records.questionZh: 你中午沒吃東西的話，下午會怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: If you don't eat at noon, what happens in the afternoon?
records.answerZh: 我中午沒吃的話，下午肚子會很餓。上課的時候肚子還會叫。
records.answerEn: If I don't eat lunch, my stomach gets really hungry in the afternoon. It even growls during class.

records.questionZh: 聽到不懂的中文詞，你會怎麼辦？
records.questionEn: What do you do when you hear a Chinese word you don't understand?
records.answerZh: 我會問台灣朋友這是什麼意思。他們通常會用簡單的話解釋。
records.answerEn: I ask my Taiwanese friends what it means. They usually explain it in simple words.

records.questionZh: 台灣一年裡你最怕哪個季節？
records.questionEn: Which season in Taiwan do you dread the most?
records.answerZh: 我最怕夏天，因為又熱又潮濕。出門走五分鐘就全身是汗。
records.answerEn: I dread summer the most because it's hot and humid. After five minutes outside I'm covered in sweat.

records.questionZh: 你晚上在家都做什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you usually do at home in the evening?
records.answerZh: 我晚上常常在家看電視。我最喜歡看美食節目。
records.answerEn: I often watch TV at home in the evening. I like food shows the most.

records.questionZh: 認識新朋友的時候，你們怎麼保持聯絡？
records.questionEn: When you meet new friends, how do you keep in touch?
records.answerZh: 我們通常會交換電話號碼。不過現在大家都用通訊軟體聊天。
records.answerEn: We usually exchange phone numbers. But nowadays everyone chats on messaging apps.

records.questionZh: 你喜歡穿紅的、藍的還是黑的衣服？
records.questionEn: Do you like wearing red, blue, or black clothes?
records.answerZh: 我最喜歡的顏色是藍色。我的衣服大部分都是藍的。
records.answerEn: My favorite color is blue. Most of my clothes are blue.

records.questionZh: 最近有什麼你推薦的電視劇嗎？
records.questionEn: Are there any TV dramas you'd recommend lately?
records.answerZh: 我最近在看一部台劇，非常好看。故事很感人，演員也演得很好。
records.answerEn: I'm watching a Taiwanese drama lately; it's really good. The story is touching and the actors are great.

records.questionZh: 什麼事情會讓你覺得心情很好？
records.questionEn: What makes you feel really good?
records.answerZh: 跟家人一起吃飯的時候，我覺得最快樂。大家聊天聊得很開心。
records.answerEn: I feel happiest when I'm eating with my family. Everyone has a great time chatting.

records.questionZh: 你覺得自己跟十年前比，有什麼不一樣？
records.questionEn: How are you different compared to ten years ago?
records.answerZh: 十年前我比較年輕，精神也比較好。現在晚上十點就想睡了。
records.answerEn: Ten years ago I was younger and had more energy. Now I want to sleep at ten p.m.

records.questionZh: 你去過台灣哪些地方？你最喜歡哪裡？
records.questionEn: Where in Taiwan have you been? Where did you like best?
records.answerZh: 我覺得墾丁最好玩。可以去海邊游泳，晚上還可以逛大街。
records.answerEn: I think Kenting is the most fun. You can swim at the beach and stroll the main street at night.

records.questionZh: 你覺得找工作的時候，什麼事最需要注意？
records.questionEn: When looking for a job, what do you think deserves the most attention?
records.answerZh: 我覺得同事很重要。如果同事人好，工作再累也不怕。
records.answerEn: I think coworkers are important. If your coworkers are nice, you don't mind how tiring the work is.

records.questionZh: 你喜歡住在安靜的地方，還是人多的地方？
records.questionEn: Do you prefer living somewhere quiet or somewhere with lots of people?
records.answerZh: 我比較喜歡熱鬧的地方。家樓下就有夜市，晚上很方便。
records.answerEn: I prefer lively places. There's a night market right downstairs from my home, so evenings are convenient.

records.questionZh: 你在家上班的時候，最怕發生什麼事？
records.questionEn: When you work from home, what are you most afraid will happen?
records.answerZh: 我最怕網路突然斷掉。這樣就不能開視訊會議了。
records.answerEn: I'm most afraid the internet will suddenly cut out. Then I can't join video meetings.

records.questionZh: 你平常怎麼去上班或上課？
records.questionEn: How do you usually get to work or class?
records.answerZh: 我平常坐公車去上班，大概二十分鐘。下雨天公車上人特別多。
records.answerEn: I usually take the bus to work; it's about twenty minutes. On rainy days the bus is especially crowded.

records.questionZh: 你晚上肚子餓的時候喜歡去哪裡逛？
records.questionEn: When you're hungry at night, where do you like to go wander around?
records.answerZh: 我最喜歡去夜市。可以一邊逛一邊吃，東西也很便宜。
records.answerEn: I like going to the night market the most. You can eat while you walk around, and things are cheap.

records.questionZh: 這次過年放假，你有什麼計畫？
records.questionEn: What are your plans for this Lunar New Year break?
records.answerZh: 我打算回國看家人。如果有時間，也想去日本玩幾天。
records.answerEn: I plan to go back to my home country to see my family. If I have time, I'd also like to spend a few days in Japan.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣過得習慣嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you gotten used to living in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我覺得在台灣生活很方便。到處都有便利商店，交通也很好。
records.answerEn: I find life in Taiwan very convenient. There are convenience stores everywhere, and transportation is great.

records.questionZh: 什麼事情會讓你很不高興？
records.questionEn: What makes you really unhappy?
records.answerZh: 有人在捷運上大聲講電話，我會很生氣。我覺得這樣很沒禮貌。
records.answerEn: When people talk loudly on the phone on the MRT, I get angry. I think it's really rude.

records.questionZh: 你平常怎麼照顧自己的身體？
records.questionEn: How do you usually take care of your body?
records.answerZh: 為了健康，我每天都走路一萬步。我也盡量少喝含糖飲料。
records.answerEn: For my health, I walk ten thousand steps every day. I also try to drink fewer sugary drinks.

records.questionZh: 你的手機會鎖起來嗎？怕別人看嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you lock your phone? Are you worried others will look at it?
records.answerZh: 我的手機有設密碼，別人打不開。但是我自己有時候也會忘記。
records.answerEn: My phone has a password, so others can't open it. But sometimes I forget it myself.

records.questionZh: 你從台北去高雄，都怎麼去？
records.questionEn: How do you get from Taipei to Kaohsiung?
records.answerZh: 我都坐高鐵去，只要一個半小時。雖然比較貴，但是很快。
records.answerEn: I always take the high-speed rail; it only takes an hour and a half. It's more expensive, but it's fast.

records.questionZh: 你家附近交通方便嗎？
records.questionEn: Is transportation convenient near your home?
records.answerZh: 很方便，我家走路五分鐘就到捷運站。去哪裡都很快。
records.answerEn: Very convenient. It's a five-minute walk from my home to the MRT station. I can get anywhere fast.

records.questionZh: 過年回家的時候，你會提早準備什麼？
records.questionEn: When going home for Lunar New Year, what do you prepare in advance?
records.answerZh: 我一定會提早上網買車票。不然過年的時候很快就賣完了。
records.answerEn: I always buy my train tickets online early. Otherwise they sell out fast around New Year.

records.questionZh: 你去超市買東西會自己帶袋子嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you bring your own bag when you shop at the supermarket?
records.answerZh: 我都會自己帶購物袋。因為在台灣，塑膠袋要另外付錢。
records.answerEn: I always bring my own shopping bag, because in Taiwan you have to pay extra for plastic bags.

records.questionZh: 你買東西習慣刷卡還是用手機付款？
records.questionEn: When you buy things, do you usually pay by card or by phone?
records.answerZh: 我還是比較常用現金。很多小吃店只收現金，不能刷卡。
records.answerEn: I still use cash more often. A lot of small eateries only take cash, not cards.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台北的東西貴不貴？
records.questionEn: Do you think things in Taipei are expensive?
records.answerZh: 我覺得台北房子的價錢很高。不過小吃的價錢還算便宜。
records.answerEn: I think housing prices in Taipei are very high. But prices for street food are still pretty cheap.

records.questionZh: 去早餐店的時候，你通常帶走還是在店裡吃？
records.questionEn: At a breakfast shop, do you usually take it to go or eat in the shop?
records.answerZh: 如果有時間，我會內用。可是上班的時候，我通常都外帶。
records.answerEn: If I have time, I eat in. But on workdays I usually get it to go.

records.questionZh: 你剛來台灣的時候，手機裝了哪些程式？
records.questionEn: When you first came to Taiwan, what apps did you install on your phone?
records.answerZh: 我下載了地圖和公車的應用程式。這樣出門就不會迷路了。
records.answerEn: I downloaded map and bus apps. That way I don't get lost when I go out.

records.questionZh: 你出去玩的時候，手機都拿來做什麼？
records.questionEn: When you go out and have fun, what do you use your phone for?
records.answerZh: 我出去玩的時候很喜歡拍照。每次都拍好幾百張。
records.answerEn: I love taking photos when I go out. Every time I take hundreds of them.

records.questionZh: 你在網路上看到喜歡的文章，會做什麼？
records.questionEn: When you see a post you like online, what do you do?
records.answerZh: 我會按讚，有時候也會留言。如果作者回我，我會很開心。
records.answerEn: I give it a like, and sometimes I leave a comment too. If the author replies, I'm really happy.

records.questionZh: 你去辦居留證的時候，需要帶什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you need to bring when applying for a residence permit?
records.answerZh: 我要準備很多資料，像是護照和照片。少帶一樣就要再跑一趟。
records.answerEn: I have to prepare a lot of documents, like my passport and photos. If I forget one, I have to make another trip.

records.questionZh: 台灣夏天常有什麼天氣讓你緊張？
records.questionEn: What kind of summer weather in Taiwan makes you nervous?
records.answerZh: 我最怕颱風。風雨很大的時候，我都不敢出門。
records.answerEn: I'm most afraid of typhoons. When the wind and rain are strong, I don't dare go out.

records.questionZh: 你喜歡台灣的冬天嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you like winter in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我很喜歡，因為台灣的冬天很暖和。在我的國家冬天會下大雪。
records.answerEn: I like it a lot, because winter in Taiwan is nice and warm. In my country it snows heavily in winter.

records.questionZh: 你最怕什麼動物？
records.questionEn: What animal are you most afraid of?
records.answerZh: 我很害怕蟑螂。看到牠的時候我會一直尖叫。
records.answerEn: I'm really scared of cockroaches. When I see one, I can't stop screaming.

records.questionZh: 你下班以後最喜歡做什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you like to do most after work?
records.answerZh: 我的興趣是做菜和看電影。下班以後我常常自己煮晚餐。
records.answerEn: My hobbies are cooking and watching movies. After work I often make dinner myself.

records.questionZh: 你去過一個地方，結果跟你想的不一樣嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you ever gone somewhere and it turned out different from what you expected?
records.answerZh: 有一次去一家很有名的餐廳，我很失望。排了很久，東西卻不好吃。
records.answerEn: Once I went to a really famous restaurant and was very disappointed. I waited in line a long time, but the food wasn't good.

records.questionZh: 這個月有什麼讓你很開心、等不及的事？
records.questionEn: Is there anything this month you're excited about and can't wait for?
records.answerZh: 我很期待下個月的連假。我要跟朋友去台東玩。
records.answerEn: I'm really looking forward to next month's long weekend. I'm going to Taitung with friends.

records.questionZh: 你覺得哪一種工作最累？
records.questionEn: What kind of job do you think is the most tiring?
records.answerZh: 我覺得外送員的工作很辛苦。不管天氣多熱，他們都要騎機車送餐。
records.answerEn: I think delivery riders have a really hard job. No matter how hot it is, they have to deliver food on scooters.

records.questionZh: 你週末喜歡做什麼運動？
records.questionEn: What exercise do you like to do on weekends?
records.answerZh: 我週末喜歡去爬山。台北附近有很多步道，很方便。
records.answerEn: On weekends I like to go hiking. There are lots of trails near Taipei, so it's convenient.

records.questionZh: 你喜歡看什麼球賽？
records.questionEn: What ball games do you like to watch?
records.answerZh: 我最喜歡看足球。可惜台灣比較多人看棒球。
records.answerEn: I like watching soccer the most. Too bad more people in Taiwan watch baseball.

records.questionZh: 你吃完晚飯以後，通常做什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you usually do after dinner?
records.answerZh: 我吃完晚飯常常去公園散步。走一走比較好消化。
records.answerEn: After dinner I often take a walk in the park. Walking a bit helps digestion.

records.questionZh: 你坐捷運的時候，都用手機做什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you do on your phone when you ride the MRT?
records.answerZh: 我坐捷運的時候常常玩手機遊戲。不小心就會坐過站。
records.answerEn: I often play phone games on the MRT. Sometimes I accidentally miss my stop.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣最適合觀光的地方是哪裡？
records.questionEn: Where do you think is the best place for sightseeing in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我覺得台南很適合去旅遊。那裡有很多老房子和好吃的小吃。
records.answerEn: I think Tainan is great for a trip. It has lots of old buildings and tasty street food.

records.questionZh: 你去外地玩的時候，都住在哪裡？
records.questionEn: Where do you stay when you travel out of town?
records.answerZh: 我通常住小旅館，比較便宜。有時候也會住民宿。
records.answerEn: I usually stay in small hotels because they're cheaper. Sometimes I stay at a B&B too.

records.questionZh: 夏天的時候你最想去哪裡？
records.questionEn: Where do you most want to go in summer?
records.answerZh: 夏天我最想去海邊。可以游泳，也可以看夕陽。
records.answerEn: In summer I most want to go to the beach. I can swim and watch the sunset.

records.questionZh: 你小時候最喜歡去哪裡看動物？
records.questionEn: As a kid, where did you most like to go see animals?
records.answerZh: 我小時候最喜歡去動物園。我特別喜歡看大象和猴子。
records.answerEn: As a kid I loved going to the zoo. I especially liked watching the elephants and monkeys.

records.questionZh: 你上次生病是什麼時候？怎麼了？
records.questionEn: When were you last sick? What happened?
records.answerZh: 我上個月發燒了，燒到三十九度。所以請了兩天假在家休息。
records.answerEn: I had a fever last month that went up to thirty-nine degrees. So I took two days off to rest at home.

records.questionZh: 頭痛的時候，你會去哪裡買藥？
records.questionEn: When you have a headache, where do you go to buy medicine?
records.answerZh: 我會去家附近的藥局買藥。藥師人很好，會跟我說怎麼吃。
records.answerEn: I go to the pharmacy near my home. The pharmacist is really nice and tells me how to take it.

records.questionZh: 你吃很冰的東西會不舒服嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you feel discomfort when you eat very cold things?
records.answerZh: 會，我的牙齒很敏感。吃剉冰的時候常常覺得很痠。
records.answerEn: Yes, my teeth are very sensitive. When I eat shaved ice, they often ache.

records.questionZh: 騎機車的時候，你要注意什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you need to pay attention to when riding a scooter?
records.answerZh: 騎機車的時候一定要很小心。尤其下雨天路很滑。
records.answerEn: You really have to be careful when riding a scooter, especially on rainy days when the roads are slippery.

records.questionZh: 你開車去百貨公司的時候，車子停哪裡？
records.questionEn: When you drive to a department store, where do you park?
records.answerZh: 我都停在百貨公司的地下停車場。不過假日常常要排隊。
records.answerEn: I always park in the department store's underground parking lot. But on holidays I often have to wait in line.

records.questionZh: 你可以告訴我去你家怎麼走嗎？
records.questionEn: Can you tell me how to get to your place?
records.answerZh: 從捷運站出來，走到第二個路口左轉。我家就在一家藥局旁邊。
records.answerEn: Come out of the MRT station and turn left at the second intersection. My home is right next to a pharmacy.

records.questionZh: 你去一個不熟的地方，怎麼找路？
records.questionEn: How do you find your way when you go somewhere unfamiliar?
records.answerZh: 我都用手機看地圖。不過有時候還是會走錯路。
records.answerEn: I always check the map on my phone. But sometimes I still go the wrong way.

records.questionZh: 坐計程車的時候，你會怎麼跟司機說路？
records.questionEn: When you take a taxi, how do you give the driver directions?
records.answerZh: 我會說「前面路口右轉」。到了就跟他說「這裡停就好」。
records.answerEn: I say "Turn right at the next intersection." When we arrive, I tell him "Just stop here."

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣的公車怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: What do you think of the buses in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我覺得公車司機開得有點快。上車以後要趕快抓好扶手。
records.answerEn: I think bus drivers drive a bit fast. After you get on, you need to grab a handrail quickly.

records.questionZh: 你常去的小吃店，有什麼特別的地方嗎？
records.questionEn: Is there anything special about the small eatery you often go to?
records.answerZh: 那家店的老闆很熱情。他每次都多給我一點湯。
records.answerEn: The owner of that shop is really friendly. He gives me a little extra soup every time.

records.questionZh: 你在網路上買衣服會遇到什麼問題？
records.questionEn: What problems do you run into when buying clothes online?
records.answerZh: 我常常不知道衣服的大小對不對。所以我都會先看尺寸表。
records.answerEn: I often don't know if the size of the clothes is right. So I always check the size chart first.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣知道哪些不用花錢的好玩地方？
records.questionEn: Do you know any fun places in Taiwan that don't cost money?
records.answerZh: 很多公園的活動都是免費的。週末還會有音樂表演可以看。
records.answerEn: Many park events are free. On weekends there are music performances to watch too.

records.questionZh: 你出門旅行一定會帶哪些東西？
records.questionEn: What things do you always bring when you travel?
records.answerZh: 我一定會帶自己的牙刷。很多旅館現在都不提供了。
records.answerEn: I always bring my own toothbrush. A lot of hotels don't provide them anymore.

records.questionZh: 台灣常常突然下雨，你出門會準備什麼？
records.questionEn: It often rains suddenly in Taiwan. What do you prepare when you go out?
records.answerZh: 我的包包裡一定有一把雨傘。就算是晴天，我也會帶著。
records.answerEn: There's always an umbrella in my bag. Even on sunny days I carry it.

records.questionZh: 你小時候在哪裡上學？
records.questionEn: Where did you go to school as a child?
records.answerZh: 我在家鄉的小學念了六年。學校很小，一個班只有二十個人。
records.answerEn: I went to elementary school in my hometown for six years. The school was small, with only twenty people per class.

records.questionZh: 你上華語課以後，回家還要做什麼？
records.questionEn: After Mandarin class, what else do you have to do at home?
records.answerZh: 回家以後我要寫作業。老師每天都給我們很多練習。
records.answerEn: After I get home, I have to do homework. The teacher gives us lots of practice every day.

records.questionZh: 你都怎麼記新學的中文詞？
records.questionEn: How do you memorize the new Chinese words you learn?
records.answerZh: 我會把生詞寫在小本子上。坐捷運的時候拿出來複習。
records.answerEn: I write the new words in a little notebook. I take it out to review on the MRT.

records.questionZh: 除了中文，你還會說什麼？
records.questionEn: Besides Chinese, what else can you speak?
records.answerZh: 我會說三種語言，英文、法文和中文。中文是最難的一個。
records.answerEn: I speak three languages: English, French, and Chinese. Chinese is the hardest one.

records.questionZh: 你上班的時候，最不喜歡做什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you dislike doing most at work?
records.answerZh: 我最不喜歡開會。有時候一開就是兩個小時。
records.answerEn: I dislike meetings the most. Sometimes one goes on for two hours.

records.questionZh: 你學生的時候有沒有做過兼職？
records.questionEn: Did you ever have a part-time job as a student?
records.answerZh: 我以前在咖啡店打工。雖然很累，但是學到很多東西。
records.answerEn: I used to work part-time at a café. It was tiring, but I learned a lot.

records.questionZh: 你去醫院的時候，誰最常照顧你？
records.questionEn: When you go to the hospital, who takes care of you the most?
records.answerZh: 醫院的護士都很親切。她們會很仔細地告訴我要注意什麼。
records.answerEn: The nurses at the hospital are all very kind. They carefully tell me what to watch out for.

records.questionZh: 你這個星期有休息的日子嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you have any days off this week?
records.answerZh: 我們公司這個星期五放假。我打算睡到中午再起來。
records.answerEn: Our company has this Friday off. I plan to sleep until noon before getting up.

records.questionZh: 看到不認識的中文字，你會怎麼辦？
records.questionEn: What do you do when you see a Chinese character you don't know?
records.answerZh: 我會用手機查字典。現在的字典還可以聽發音，很方便。
records.answerEn: I look it up in a dictionary on my phone. Dictionaries now even let you hear the pronunciation, which is very convenient.

records.questionZh: 上課的時候，你怎麼記住老師說的話？
records.questionEn: In class, how do you remember what the teacher says?
records.answerZh: 我上課都會寫筆記。回家以後再看一次，比較記得住。
records.answerEn: I always take notes in class. I read them again at home, so I remember better.

records.questionZh: 你住的地方可以自己煮東西嗎？
records.questionEn: Can you cook for yourself where you live?
records.answerZh: 可以，我們家有一個小廚房。週末我常常自己煮義大利麵。
records.answerEn: Yes, our place has a small kitchen. On weekends I often make spaghetti myself.

records.questionZh: 你住幾樓？每天怎麼上下樓？
records.questionEn: What floor do you live on? How do you go up and down every day?
records.answerZh: 我住在十二樓，每天都坐電梯。有時候人太多，要等很久。
records.answerEn: I live on the twelfth floor and take the elevator every day. Sometimes there are too many people and I have to wait a long time.

records.questionZh: 你買太多菜的時候，都放在哪裡？
records.questionEn: When you buy too many groceries, where do you put them?
records.answerZh: 我都放在冰箱裡。不過冰箱太小，常常放不下。
records.answerEn: I put them in the fridge. But the fridge is too small, so things often don't fit.

records.questionZh: 在台北租房子，每個月要花多少錢？
records.questionEn: How much does it cost each month to rent a place in Taipei?
records.answerZh: 我每個月的房租是一萬兩千塊。水電費要另外算。
records.answerEn: My rent is twelve thousand dollars a month. Water and electricity are extra.

records.questionZh: 你多久整理一次家裡？
records.questionEn: How often do you tidy up your home?
records.answerZh: 我每個週末都會打掃家裡。我覺得乾淨的房間讓人心情很好。
records.answerEn: I clean my home every weekend. I think a clean room puts people in a good mood.

records.questionZh: 你喝完的寶特瓶都怎麼處理？
records.questionEn: What do you do with your plastic bottles after you finish drinking?
records.answerZh: 我都會拿去回收。台灣的垃圾分類做得很好。
records.answerEn: I always take them to be recycled. Taiwan does a great job sorting garbage.

records.questionZh: 你晚上都自己煮還是在外面吃？
records.questionEn: In the evening, do you cook yourself or eat out?
records.answerZh: 我很少自己做飯，因為下班太累了。我通常買便當回家吃。
records.answerEn: I rarely cook for myself because I'm too tired after work. I usually buy a bento to eat at home.

records.questionZh: 你要寄東西回國的時候，會去哪裡寄？
records.questionEn: When you want to send something back home, where do you go to send it?
records.answerZh: 我會去郵局寄。郵局的人很親切，會教我怎麼填單子。
records.answerEn: I go to the post office. The staff there are very kind and show me how to fill out the forms.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣有去過朋友家作客嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you ever been a guest at a friend's home in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 有，上個月同事邀請我去他家吃飯。他媽媽做了一大桌菜。
records.answerEn: Yes, last month a coworker invited me to his home for dinner. His mom made a whole table of dishes.

records.questionZh: 你來台灣以後，有沒有注意到什麼有趣的事？
records.questionEn: Since coming to Taiwan, have you noticed anything interesting?
records.answerZh: 我發現台灣人很喜歡排隊。只要有人排隊，就會有更多人來排。
records.answerEn: I've found that Taiwanese people really like lining up. As soon as someone lines up, more people join.

records.questionZh: 你生病的時候，誰會照顧你、問你好不好？
records.questionEn: When you're sick, who takes care of you and asks how you are?
records.answerZh: 我的室友很關心我。她每天都會問我好一點了沒。
records.answerEn: My roommate really cares about me. Every day she asks if I'm feeling better.

records.questionZh: 你上班或上課曾經晚到過嗎？為什麼？
records.questionEn: Have you ever arrived late to work or class? Why?
records.answerZh: 我上個禮拜遲到了一次。因為公車一直沒來，等了二十分鐘。
records.answerEn: I was late once last week, because the bus never came and I waited twenty minutes.

records.questionZh: 你週末早上通常睡到幾點？
records.questionEn: On weekend mornings, until what time do you usually sleep?
records.answerZh: 我週末都睡到十點才起來。起來以後去吃早午餐。
records.answerEn: On weekends I sleep until ten before getting up. After I get up, I go have brunch.

records.questionZh: 你跟台灣朋友去餐廳吃飯，通常誰決定吃什麼？
records.questionEn: When you eat out with Taiwanese friends, who usually decides what to eat?
records.answerZh: 通常是台灣朋友幫我點菜。他們知道哪些菜比較好吃。
records.answerEn: Usually my Taiwanese friends order for me. They know which dishes are better.

records.questionZh: 朋友告訴你他找到新工作了，你會說什麼？
records.questionEn: If a friend tells you they found a new job, what would you say?
records.answerZh: 我會跟他說「恭喜你！」然後說要請他吃飯慶祝。
records.answerEn: I'd tell him "Congratulations!" Then I'd offer to treat him to a meal to celebrate.

records.questionZh: 你參加過台灣的婚禮嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you ever been to a Taiwanese wedding?
records.answerZh: 去年我的同事結婚，我去喝了他的喜酒。菜很多，大家都吃得很飽。
records.answerEn: Last year my coworker got married, and I went to his wedding banquet. There was lots of food, and everyone ate their fill.

records.questionZh: 你參加過什麼比賽或抽獎嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you ever entered a contest or a prize draw?
records.answerZh: 我去年參加公司尾牙的抽獎。我得到了一台吸塵器，很開心。
records.answerEn: Last year I joined the prize draw at my company's year-end party. I got a vacuum cleaner and was really happy.

records.questionZh: 你聽得懂捷運上的廣播嗎？
records.questionEn: Can you understand the announcements on the MRT?
records.answerZh: 有時候聽不太清楚，因為講得很快。我會看螢幕上的字。
records.answerEn: Sometimes I can't hear them clearly because they talk fast. I read the words on the screen.

records.questionZh: 你常常去圖書館嗎？在那裡做什麼？
records.questionEn: Do you often go to the library? What do you do there?
records.answerZh: 我常常去圖書館使用電腦。那裡又安靜又有冷氣。
records.answerEn: I often go to the library to use the computers. It's quiet and air-conditioned there.

records.questionZh: 有朋友從國外來台灣，你會帶他們去哪裡？
records.questionEn: If friends come to Taiwan from abroad, where would you take them?
records.answerZh: 我會帶他們去參觀故宮博物院。那裡有很多古代的東西。
records.answerEn: I'd take them to visit the National Palace Museum. It has lots of ancient things.

records.questionZh: 台灣過年的時候，大人會給小孩什麼？
records.questionEn: During Lunar New Year in Taiwan, what do adults give children?
records.answerZh: 大人會給小孩紅包。我去年也收到房東給的紅包。
records.answerEn: Adults give children red envelopes. Last year I got a red envelope from my landlord too.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣人對外國人怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: How do you think Taiwanese people treat foreigners?
records.answerZh: 我覺得台灣人很熱情。我迷路的時候，常常有人主動幫我。
records.answerEn: I think Taiwanese people are very warm. When I get lost, people often offer to help me.

records.questionZh: 你覺得在台灣辦居留證容易嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think it's easy to get a residence permit in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我覺得有一點麻煩。要準備很多資料，還要排很久的隊。
records.answerEn: I think it's a bit of a hassle. You have to prepare lots of documents and wait in line a long time.

records.questionZh: 你覺得學中文對你的工作有幫助嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think learning Chinese helps with your job?
records.answerZh: 學中文非常有用。我現在可以直接跟台灣客戶聊天。
records.answerEn: Learning Chinese is really useful. Now I can talk directly with Taiwanese clients.

records.questionZh: 這個週末你可以一起去看電影嗎？
records.questionEn: Can you go see a movie together this weekend?
records.answerZh: 我星期六有空，星期天要上班。我們星期六下午去好不好？
records.answerEn: I'm free on Saturday, but I work on Sunday. How about we go Saturday afternoon?

records.questionZh: 你學中文的時候，都怎麼練習？
records.questionEn: How do you practice when you study Chinese?
records.answerZh: 我每天都很努力練習說中文。我會跟早餐店的阿姨聊天。
records.answerEn: I work hard at practicing speaking Chinese every day. I chat with the auntie at the breakfast shop.

records.questionZh: 你上完華語課以後，有什麼打算？
records.questionEn: What are your plans after you finish your Mandarin course?
records.answerZh: 上完華語課之後，我想在台灣找工作。我很喜歡這裡的生活。
records.answerEn: After I finish my Mandarin course, I want to find a job in Taiwan. I really like life here.

records.questionZh: 你平常怎麼知道台灣最近發生的事？
records.questionEn: How do you usually find out what's been happening in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我每天早上都會看新聞。看不懂的地方就查字典。
records.answerEn: I watch the news every morning. When I don't understand something, I look it up in a dictionary.

records.questionZh: 你以前做過什麼工作？
records.questionEn: What jobs have you done before?
records.answerZh: 我有三年當英文老師的經驗。我覺得教小孩很有意思。
records.answerEn: I have three years of experience as an English teacher. I find teaching kids really interesting.

records.questionZh: 你最喜歡台灣哪個地方？為什麼？
records.questionEn: Which place in Taiwan do you like best? Why?
records.answerZh: 我最喜歡台中這個城市。天氣好，生活也很方便。
records.answerEn: I like the city of Taichung best. The weather is nice and life is convenient.

records.questionZh: 你晚上睡不著的時候怎麼辦？
records.questionEn: What do you do when you can't sleep at night?
records.answerZh: 我試過很多辦法，像是喝熱牛奶。最有用的是不要看手機。
records.answerEn: I've tried lots of ways, like drinking hot milk. The most effective is not looking at my phone.

records.questionZh: 你平常怎麼看時間？
records.questionEn: How do you usually check the time?
records.answerZh: 我習慣戴手錶看時間。這樣不用一直拿出手機。
records.answerEn: I'm used to wearing a watch to check the time. That way I don't have to keep taking out my phone.

records.questionZh: 夏天的時候，你喜歡穿什麼衣服？
records.questionEn: What do you like to wear in summer?
records.answerZh: 夏天我最喜歡穿裙子，比較涼快。可是騎機車的時候不太方便。
records.answerEn: In summer I like wearing skirts best because they're cooler. But they're not very convenient when riding a scooter.

records.questionZh: 你最會煮哪一道菜？
records.questionEn: What dish are you best at cooking?
records.answerZh: 我最會做蛋炒飯。用前一天的白飯炒，最好吃。
records.answerEn: I'm best at egg fried rice. It's tastiest when you fry it with rice from the day before.

records.questionZh: 你帶外國朋友去吃台灣美食，會點什麼？
records.questionEn: When you take foreign friends to eat Taiwanese food, what do you order?
records.answerZh: 我一定會點小籠包。咬的時候要小心，裡面的湯很燙。
records.answerEn: I always order soup dumplings. You have to be careful when you bite in, because the soup inside is very hot.

records.questionZh: 台灣有什麼你一開始不敢吃的東西？
records.questionEn: Is there any food in Taiwan you didn't dare eat at first?
records.answerZh: 我一開始不敢吃臭豆腐，因為味道太重了。吃了以後發現很好吃。
records.answerEn: At first I didn't dare eat stinky tofu because the smell was too strong. After trying it, I found it delicious.

records.questionZh: 你最喜歡用什麼蔬菜做菜？
records.questionEn: What vegetable do you most like to cook with?
records.answerZh: 我最喜歡用馬鈴薯做菜。可以煮咖哩，也可以做薯條。
records.answerEn: I like cooking with potatoes the most. You can make curry or French fries.

records.questionZh: 台灣夏天你最喜歡吃什麼水果？
records.questionEn: What fruit do you like most in Taiwan's summer?
records.answerZh: 我最喜歡吃芒果。夏天一定要吃一碗芒果冰。
records.answerEn: I like mangoes the most. In summer I have to have a bowl of mango shaved ice.

records.questionZh: 你生日的時候會吃什麼甜的東西？
records.questionEn: What sweet things do you eat on your birthday?
records.answerZh: 我生日的時候一定會吃蛋糕。我最喜歡巧克力口味的。
records.answerEn: I always eat cake on my birthday. My favorite is chocolate flavor.

records.questionZh: 你去夜市最常買什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you buy most often at the night market?
records.answerZh: 我去夜市最常買雞排。又大又香，一個人吃不完。
records.answerEn: At the night market I most often buy a fried chicken cutlet. It's big and fragrant; one person can't finish it.

records.questionZh: 吃炸雞的時候，你喜歡配什麼飲料？
records.questionEn: What drink do you like to have with fried chicken?
records.answerZh: 吃炸雞一定要配可樂。不過我現在都改喝無糖的。
records.answerEn: Fried chicken has to go with cola. But now I've switched to sugar-free.

records.questionZh: 你買飲料的時候，會自己帶環保餐具嗎？
records.questionEn: When you buy drinks, do you bring your own reusable utensils?
records.answerZh: 我會帶自己的吸管和杯子。這樣比較環保，也可以少用塑膠。
records.answerEn: I bring my own straw and cup. It's better for the environment, and I use less plastic.

records.questionZh: 你今天出門的時候，天氣怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: What was the weather like when you went out today?
records.answerZh: 今天天空很藍，一朵雲都沒有。可是太陽很大，很熱。
records.answerEn: The sky was really blue today, without a single cloud. But the sun was strong and it was hot.

records.questionZh: 你覺得你住的城市環境怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: What do you think of the environment in the city where you live?
records.answerZh: 我住的地方車很多，空氣不太好。所以我常常去山上走走。
records.answerEn: There are lots of cars where I live, so the air isn't very good. That's why I often go walk in the mountains.

records.questionZh: 你這陣子在忙什麼？
records.questionEn: What have you been busy with these days?
records.answerZh: 我最近在準備華語考試。每天下班都要念兩個小時。
records.answerEn: Recently I've been preparing for a Mandarin exam. I study two hours every day after work.

records.questionZh: 你覺得幾歲結婚比較好？
records.questionEn: At what age do you think it's best to get married?
records.answerZh: 我覺得年紀不是最重要的。找到對的人比較重要。
records.answerEn: I don't think age is the most important thing. Finding the right person matters more.

records.questionZh: 你家裡誰對你影響最大？
records.questionEn: Who in your family has influenced you the most?
records.answerZh: 我的父親對我影響最大。他教我做事一定要認真。
records.answerEn: My father has influenced me the most. He taught me to always be serious about what I do.

records.questionZh: 過年的時候，你們家會做什麼？
records.questionEn: What does your family do over Lunar New Year?
records.answerZh: 過年的時候，很多親戚會來我們家。大家一起吃年夜飯，很熱鬧。
records.answerEn: Over New Year, lots of relatives come to our house. Everyone eats the New Year's Eve dinner together, and it's very lively.

records.questionZh: 你的機車沒油了，你會去哪裡？
records.questionEn: If your scooter runs out of gas, where do you go?
records.answerZh: 我會去最近的加油站加油。台灣的加油站很多，很方便。
records.answerEn: I go to the nearest gas station to fill up. There are lots of gas stations in Taiwan, so it's convenient.

records.questionZh: 你上班前都在哪裡買吃的？
records.questionEn: Where do you buy food before work?
records.answerZh: 我都在家附近的早餐店買。我常點蛋餅和大冰奶。
records.answerEn: I always buy it at the breakfast shop near my home. I often order an egg crepe and a large iced milk tea.

records.questionZh: 你跟朋友約在捷運站的時候，都在哪裡等？
records.questionEn: When you meet a friend at an MRT station, where do you wait?
records.answerZh: 我們通常約在便利商店門口等。這樣比較好找。
records.answerEn: We usually wait at the entrance of the convenience store. That way it's easier to find each other.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣的薪水怎麼拿？
records.questionEn: How do you get paid in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 公司會把薪水匯到我的銀行帳戶。每個月五號就會收到。
records.answerEn: My company transfers my salary to my bank account. I get it on the fifth of every month.

records.questionZh: 你買東西拿到的收據，都怎麼處理？
records.questionEn: What do you do with the receipts you get when you buy things?
records.answerZh: 我會把統一發票留起來對獎。有一次我中了兩百塊！
records.answerEn: I keep my uniform invoices to check the lottery numbers. Once I won two hundred dollars!

records.questionZh: 你住的地方每個月要付哪些錢？
records.questionEn: What bills do you have to pay for your place?
records.answerZh: 我要付房租、電費和水費。水費很便宜，兩個月才一百多塊。
records.answerEn: I have to pay rent, electricity, and the water bill. The water bill is cheap, just over a hundred dollars every two months.

records.questionZh: 你寄明信片回國的時候，要準備什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you need to prepare when you send a postcard home?
records.answerZh: 我要先去郵局買郵票。貼好以後再丟進郵筒。
records.answerEn: First I go to the post office to buy stamps. After sticking them on, I drop it in the mailbox.

records.questionZh: 你來台灣的時候，需要辦哪些手續？
records.questionEn: What paperwork did you need to do when you came to Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我要申請居留證和健保卡。花了好幾個星期才辦好。
records.answerEn: I had to apply for a residence permit and a health insurance card. It took several weeks to get it all done.

records.questionZh: 你住的地方，房子的主人人好不好？
records.questionEn: Is the owner of the place you live in nice?
records.answerZh: 我的房東人很好。東西壞了，他都會馬上來修。
records.answerEn: My landlord is very nice. When something breaks, he comes to fix it right away.

records.questionZh: 你家裡你最喜歡哪個空間？
records.questionEn: Which space in your home do you like best?
records.answerZh: 我最喜歡我的臥室。裡面有一張很舒服的床，我常在那裡看書。
records.answerEn: I like my bedroom best. There's a really comfortable bed in it, and I often read there.

records.questionZh: 你中午帶便當去公司，怎麼把它弄熱？
records.questionEn: When you bring a lunchbox to work, how do you heat it up?
records.answerZh: 我都用公司的微波爐熱便當。中午的時候要排隊才能用。
records.answerEn: I always heat my lunch in the office microwave. At noon you have to wait in line to use it.

records.questionZh: 在台灣倒垃圾的時候，你要注意什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you need to pay attention to when taking out the trash in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 要先做好資源回收。紙類、塑膠和鐵罐都要分開放。
records.answerEn: You have to sort the recycling first. Paper, plastic, and cans all go separately.

records.questionZh: 你都去哪裡買新鮮的菜和肉？
records.questionEn: Where do you buy fresh vegetables and meat?
records.answerZh: 我週末會去家附近的菜市場。那裡的菜很新鮮，老闆還會送蔥。
records.answerEn: On weekends I go to the traditional market near my home. The vegetables are fresh, and the vendors even throw in free green onions.

records.questionZh: 你最常穿什麼樣的褲子？
records.questionEn: What kind of pants do you wear most often?
records.answerZh: 我最常穿牛仔褲，因為很耐穿。不過夏天穿有點熱。
records.answerEn: I wear jeans most often because they're durable. But they're a bit hot in summer.

records.questionZh: 你早上都怎麼叫自己起床？
records.questionEn: How do you get yourself up in the morning?
records.answerZh: 我每天都會設三個鬧鐘。不然我一定起不來。
records.answerEn: I set three alarm clocks every day. Otherwise I definitely can't get up.

records.questionZh: 你點飲料的時候，冰的部分怎麼選？
records.questionEn: When you order a drink, how do you choose the ice level?
records.answerZh: 我通常點少冰，因為冰塊太多會沖淡味道。冬天我會點去冰。
records.answerEn: I usually order light ice, because too many ice cubes water down the flavor. In winter I order no ice.

records.questionZh: 你吃得了很辣的東西嗎？
records.questionEn: Can you handle really spicy food?
records.answerZh: 我很能吃辣。吃麵的時候我一定會加很多辣椒。
records.answerEn: I can eat really spicy food. When I eat noodles, I always add lots of chili peppers.

records.questionZh: 吃完飯以後，你喜歡再吃點甜的嗎？
records.questionEn: After a meal, do you like to eat something sweet?
records.answerZh: 我很喜歡吃甜點。我最喜歡的是豆花加花生。
records.answerEn: I really like desserts. My favorite is tofu pudding with peanuts.

records.questionZh: 你下雨天不想出門的時候，怎麼吃晚餐？
records.questionEn: On rainy days when you don't want to go out, how do you get dinner?
records.answerZh: 我會叫外送。雖然比較貴，但是不用出門很方便。
records.answerEn: I order delivery. It's more expensive, but it's convenient not having to go out.

records.questionZh: 你要去看演唱會，會怎麼準備？
records.questionEn: If you want to go to a concert, how do you prepare?
records.answerZh: 我會在開賣那天準時上網訂票。熱門的演唱會幾分鐘就賣完了。
records.answerEn: I go online right on time the day tickets go on sale to book them. Popular concerts sell out in minutes.

records.questionZh: 你搬來台灣的時候帶了多少東西？
records.questionEn: How much stuff did you bring when you moved to Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我只帶了兩個大行李箱。其他的東西都是來台灣以後才買的。
records.answerEn: I only brought two big suitcases. Everything else I bought after coming to Taiwan.

records.questionZh: 你會推薦朋友去台北附近哪些地方玩？
records.questionEn: What places around Taipei would you recommend to friends?
records.answerZh: 我會推薦九份和淡水，這兩個景點都很漂亮。晚上去淡水還可以看夕陽。
records.answerEn: I'd recommend Jiufen and Tamsui; both sights are beautiful. In Tamsui you can watch the sunset in the evening too.

records.questionZh: 你回國的時候，會買什麼送給家人？
records.questionEn: When you go back home, what do you buy for your family?
records.answerZh: 我會買鳳梨酥當紀念品。家人和朋友都說很好吃。
records.answerEn: I buy pineapple cakes as souvenirs. My family and friends all say they're delicious.

records.questionZh: 你感冒的時候，哪裡最不舒服？
records.questionEn: When you have a cold, where do you feel worst?
records.answerZh: 我感冒的時候喉嚨會很痛。說話跟吞東西都很難過。
records.answerEn: When I have a cold, my throat really hurts. Talking and swallowing are both painful.

records.questionZh: 你牙齒痛的時候怎麼辦？
records.questionEn: What do you do when you have a toothache?
records.answerZh: 我會馬上去看牙醫。用健保卡看牙齒，不會很貴。
records.answerEn: I go see a dentist right away. With my health insurance card, dental care isn't very expensive.

records.questionZh: 你切菜的時候受過傷嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you ever hurt yourself while cutting vegetables?
records.answerZh: 有一次我切菜切到手指，流了很多血。從那時候開始我都很小心。
records.answerEn: Once I cut my finger while chopping vegetables and bled a lot. Since then I've always been careful.

records.questionZh: 你覺得在公共場所應該禁止什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you think should be banned in public places?
records.answerZh: 我覺得不應該在公園抽菸。小孩子在旁邊玩，對他們不好。
records.answerEn: I don't think people should smoke in parks. Kids are playing nearby, and it's bad for them.

records.questionZh: 你找工作的時候，最緊張的是什麼？
records.questionEn: What makes you most nervous when looking for a job?
records.answerZh: 我最緊張的是面試。我怕說錯話，所以會先在家練習。
records.answerEn: The interview makes me most nervous. I'm afraid of saying the wrong thing, so I practice at home first.

records.questionZh: 你常常跟家鄉的家人說話嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you often talk with your family back home?
records.answerZh: 我每個星期都會跟家人聯絡。我們通常用視訊聊天。
records.answerEn: I get in touch with my family every week. We usually chat over video call.

records.questionZh: 如果你的手機在路上壞了，你會怎麼辦？
records.questionEn: If your phone breaks while you're out, what would you do?
records.answerZh: 我會先拿去手機行請他們處理。如果修不好，就只好買新的。
records.answerEn: First I'd take it to a phone shop and have them deal with it. If they can't fix it, I'll have to buy a new one.

records.questionZh: 你要買新電腦的時候，會問誰？
records.questionEn: Who do you ask when you want to buy a new computer?
records.answerZh: 我會問懂電腦的朋友的意見。他們的建議通常都很有用。
records.answerEn: I ask for the opinion of friends who know computers. Their advice is usually very useful.

records.questionZh: 這學期你最緊張的考試是什麼時候？
records.questionEn: When is the exam you're most nervous about this semester?
records.answerZh: 下個星期就是期中考了。我每天都在圖書館念書。
records.answerEn: Midterms are next week. I study at the library every day.

records.questionZh: 你上次考試考得怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: How did you do on your last test?
records.answerZh: 我上次考試的分數不太好。下次我要更認真準備。
records.answerEn: My score on the last test wasn't very good. Next time I'll prepare more seriously.

records.questionZh: 你身邊有沒有從國外來台灣讀書的朋友？
records.questionEn: Do you have any friends who came to Taiwan from abroad to study?
records.answerZh: 我在台灣認識很多留學生，大部分是從日本和越南來的。我們常常一起去夜市吃東西。
records.answerEn: I know a lot of international students in Taiwan; most of them are from Japan and Vietnam. We often go to the night market together to eat.

records.questionZh: 你上大學的時候，有參加什麼課外活動嗎？
records.questionEn: When you were in college, did you join any extracurricular activities?
records.answerZh: 我大學的時候參加了好幾個社團，最喜歡的是登山社。每個月都會跟社員一起去爬山。
records.answerEn: In college I joined several clubs, and my favorite was the hiking club. Every month I went hiking with the other members.

records.questionZh: 最近有什麼事讓你很期待、心情特別好嗎？
records.questionEn: Is there anything recently that you're really looking forward to and that puts you in a great mood?
records.answerZh: 下個月我要去花蓮玩，我現在就覺得好興奮。我已經開始查要去哪裡吃東西了。
records.answerEn: Next month I'm going on a trip to Hualien, and I'm already so excited. I've started looking up where to eat.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有哪個朋友的生活，是你很想要的？
records.questionEn: Is there a friend whose life you'd really like to have?
records.answerZh: 我很羨慕我的室友，她每天都可以在家上班。我每天都要擠捷運，真的好累。
records.answerEn: I really envy my roommate; she gets to work from home every day. I have to squeeze onto the MRT every day, and it's exhausting.

records.questionZh: 如果你跟朋友見面遲到了，你會跟他說什麼？
records.questionEn: If you're late meeting a friend, what would you say to them?
records.answerZh: 我會先說「真抱歉，我坐錯捷運了」。然後請他喝一杯飲料當作道歉。
records.answerEn: I'd first say, Sorry, I took the wrong MRT line. Then I'd buy them a drink as an apology.

records.questionZh: 你小時候是安靜的孩子，還是很愛說話、跑來跑去的孩子？
records.questionEn: As a child, were you quiet, or did you love talking and running around?
records.answerZh: 我小時候很活潑，在家裡一直跑來跑去。我媽媽常說我一分鐘都坐不住。
records.answerEn: I was very lively as a kid and ran around the house all the time. My mom often said I couldn't sit still for even a minute.

records.questionZh: 你喜歡跟什麼樣的人當朋友？
records.questionEn: What kind of people do you like to be friends with?
records.answerZh: 我喜歡跟幽默的人當朋友，跟他們聊天很輕鬆。我有一個同事很會講笑話，大家都很喜歡他。
records.answerEn: I like being friends with humorous people; chatting with them is relaxing. I have a coworker who's great at telling jokes, and everyone likes him.

records.questionZh: 你覺得自己做什麼工作會做得最好？
records.questionEn: What kind of job do you think you'd be best at?
records.answerZh: 我覺得我很適合當老師，因為我很有耐心。而且我很喜歡跟小朋友聊天。
records.answerEn: I think I'm well suited to being a teacher because I'm very patient. And I really like talking with kids.

records.questionZh: 你最近買過什麼東西，覺得買得很值得？
records.questionEn: What have you bought recently that you felt was really worth it?
records.answerZh: 我上個月在網路上買了一雙球鞋，打了五折，真的很划算。穿起來也很舒服。
records.answerEn: Last month I bought a pair of sneakers online at half price, which was a really good deal. They're comfortable too.

records.questionZh: 你當初來台灣，主要是為了什麼？
records.questionEn: When you first came to Taiwan, what was your main reason?
records.answerZh: 我來台灣的目的是學中文。我希望一年以後可以用中文跟台灣朋友聊天。
records.answerEn: My purpose in coming to Taiwan was to learn Chinese. I hope that in a year I can chat with Taiwanese friends in Chinese.

records.questionZh: 農曆新年的時候，你通常都在做什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you usually do during Lunar New Year?
records.answerZh: 春節的時候我會跟台灣朋友回他家過年。他媽媽每次都煮一大桌菜。
records.answerEn: During the Spring Festival I go back to my Taiwanese friend's home to celebrate the New Year. His mom always cooks a huge table of food.

records.questionZh: 中秋節的時候，你都吃什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you eat during the Mid-Autumn Festival?
records.answerZh: 中秋節我會跟朋友在外面烤肉，也會吃月餅。我最喜歡蛋黃口味的。
records.answerEn: At Mid-Autumn Festival I barbecue outside with friends and also eat mooncakes. My favorite is the egg yolk kind.

records.questionZh: 你跟你最好的朋友有什麼一樣的興趣嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you and your best friend share any interests?
records.answerZh: 我跟我最好的朋友有相同的興趣，我們都很喜歡爬山。放假的時候我們常常一起去陽明山。
records.answerEn: My best friend and I have the same interests; we both love hiking. On days off we often go to Yangmingshan together.

records.questionZh: 你覺得自己個性上有什麼地方需要改？
records.questionEn: What do you think you need to change about your personality?
records.answerZh: 我最大的缺點是常常遲到。我已經開始提早十分鐘出門了。
records.answerEn: My biggest flaw is that I'm often late. I've already started leaving home ten minutes earlier.

records.questionZh: 你最近看了什麼好看的書或影集？在講什麼？
records.questionEn: What good book or series have you read or watched recently? What's it about?
records.answerZh: 我最近在看一部台灣的影集，內容是在講夜市一家人的故事。很好笑，也很感人。
records.answerEn: I've recently been watching a Taiwanese series; its content is the story of a family at a night market. It's funny and touching.

records.questionZh: 你覺得在台灣騎機車安全嗎？為什麼？
records.questionEn: Do you think riding a scooter in Taiwan is safe? Why?
records.answerZh: 我對這件事的看法是，騎機車很方便，可是要很小心。台灣的路上車子很多，我每次騎都很緊張。
records.answerEn: My view on this is that riding a scooter is convenient, but you have to be careful. There are lots of vehicles on Taiwan's roads, and I'm nervous every time I ride.

records.questionZh: 你現在住在哪裡？在做什麼工作？
records.questionEn: Where do you live now, and what work do you do?
records.answerZh: 我目前住在台北，在一家貿易公司上班。每天都坐捷運上下班。
records.answerEn: I currently live in Taipei and work at a trading company. I take the MRT to and from work every day.

records.questionZh: 搭火車或看電影的時候，你喜歡坐哪裡？
records.questionEn: When you take the train or watch a movie, where do you like to sit?
records.answerZh: 我喜歡坐靠窗的位置，可以看外面的風景。看電影的話，我喜歡坐中間。
records.answerEn: I like a window seat so I can see the scenery outside. At the movies, I like to sit in the middle.

records.questionZh: 你看影片的時候，最受不了什麼？
records.questionEn: What can you least stand when watching videos?
records.answerZh: 我最受不了一直跳出來的廣告。有時候一部影片要看三、四個廣告，真的很煩。
records.answerEn: What I can least stand is ads that keep popping up. Sometimes one video makes you watch three or four ads, which is really annoying.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有上台唱歌或跳舞的經驗？
records.questionEn: Have you ever sung or danced on stage?
records.answerZh: 我去年在公司的尾牙上台表演唱歌。我很緊張，可是大家都很捧場。
records.answerEn: Last year I got on stage and performed a song at my company's year-end party. I was nervous, but everyone was really supportive.

records.questionZh: 你覺得自己是一個常常中獎的人嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think you're someone who often wins prizes?
records.answerZh: 我的運氣不太好，從來沒中過發票。可是我朋友上個月中了兩百塊。
records.answerEn: My luck isn't great; I've never won the receipt lottery. But my friend won two hundred dollars last month.

records.questionZh: 有沒有什麼事，你只跟最好的朋友說過？
records.questionEn: Is there anything you've only told your best friend?
records.answerZh: 有啊，可是這是我的祕密，不能告訴你。我只能說跟我喜歡的人有關。
records.answerEn: Yes, but it's my secret, so I can't tell you. All I can say is that it has to do with someone I like.

records.questionZh: 你最喜歡台灣的哪些東西，常常買來送朋友？
records.questionEn: Which Taiwanese things do you like most and often buy as gifts for friends?
records.answerZh: 我常常買台灣的茶葉和鳳梨酥送朋友。這些產品包裝很漂亮，大家都很喜歡。
records.answerEn: I often buy Taiwanese tea and pineapple cakes for friends. These products are nicely packaged, and everyone loves them.

records.questionZh: 你早上起床的時候通常覺得怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: How do you usually feel when you wake up in the morning?
records.answerZh: 我早上常常沒什麼精神，一定要先喝一杯咖啡。喝完以後才比較清醒。
records.answerEn: I often don't have much energy in the morning, so I have to drink a cup of coffee first. Only after that do I feel more awake.

records.questionZh: 你從小在家裡都說什麼話？
records.questionEn: What language did you speak at home growing up?
records.answerZh: 我的母語是英文，從小在家都說英文。不過我奶奶會跟我說一點西班牙文。
records.answerEn: My native language is English, and I've spoken English at home since I was little. But my grandma speaks a little Spanish with me.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台北有很多適合小朋友玩的地方嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think Taipei has a lot of places for kids to play?
records.answerZh: 我覺得滿多的，很多公園都有兒童遊樂區。週末常常看到爸媽帶小孩去玩。
records.answerEn: I think there are quite a few; many parks have children's play areas. On weekends you often see parents taking their kids there.

records.questionZh: 你剛來台灣的時候，有什麼不習慣的地方？
records.questionEn: When you first came to Taiwan, what weren't you used to?
records.answerZh: 我剛來的時候不太適應這裡的天氣，夏天真的太熱了。現在我出門一定會帶水和雨傘。
records.answerEn: When I first came, I couldn't really adapt to the weather here; summer is way too hot. Now I always bring water and an umbrella when I go out.

records.questionZh: 你來台灣以後，體重有改變嗎？
records.questionEn: Has your weight changed since you came to Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我來台灣以後體重增加了五公斤。因為夜市的東西太好吃了！
records.answerEn: My weight has increased by five kilos since I came to Taiwan. The night market food is just too good!

records.questionZh: 聽到哪一首歌或吃到什麼東西，會讓你想家？
records.questionEn: What song or food makes you homesick?
records.answerZh: 每次聽到我們國家的老歌，我就會想起家人。我常常在睡覺前聽。
records.answerEn: Every time I hear old songs from my country, I think of my family. I often listen to them before bed.

records.questionZh: 第一次用自動售票機的時候，你知道怎麼操作嗎？
records.questionEn: The first time you used a ticket machine, did you know how to operate it?
records.answerZh: 我一開始不會用，後來看了旁邊的說明才知道。現在我都直接刷卡進站了。
records.answerEn: At first I didn't know how, but then I read the instructions next to it and figured it out. Now I just tap my card to enter the station.

records.questionZh: 如果同事請你週末幫忙加班，你會答應嗎？
records.questionEn: If a coworker asked you to help with overtime on the weekend, would you agree?
records.answerZh: 我通常會拒絕，因為週末是我休息的時間。不過如果真的很急，我還是會幫忙。
records.answerEn: I usually say no, because weekends are my time to rest. But if it's really urgent, I'll still help.

records.questionZh: 你住的地方附近，有什麼方便的服務？
records.questionEn: What convenient services are there near where you live?
records.answerZh: 我家樓下的便利商店提供很多服務，可以繳費、印東西，也可以拿包裹。真的很方便。
records.answerEn: The convenience store downstairs offers lots of services: you can pay bills, print things, and pick up packages. It's really convenient.

records.questionZh: 學中文的時候，你有沒有想過不學了？
records.questionEn: While learning Chinese, have you ever thought about quitting?
records.answerZh: 有啊，剛開始學聲調的時候，我差點就放棄了。還好我的老師一直鼓勵我。
records.answerEn: Yes, when I first started learning tones, I almost gave up. Luckily my teacher kept encouraging me.

records.questionZh: 你多久整理一次房間？
records.questionEn: How often do you tidy your room?
records.answerZh: 我大概每個週末收拾一次房間。平常太忙了，東西常常亂放。
records.answerEn: I tidy my room about once every weekend. I'm too busy during the week, so things often get left lying around.

records.questionZh: 你去過台灣朋友的家嗎？去之前你會準備什麼？
records.questionEn: Have you been to a Taiwanese friend's home? What would you prepare before going?
records.answerZh: 我上次去拜訪朋友的爸媽，帶了一盒水果過去。他們很高興，還留我吃晚飯。
records.answerEn: Last time I visited my friend's parents, I brought a box of fruit. They were very happy and even had me stay for dinner.

records.questionZh: 你平常會用什麼方法讓自己少花一點錢？
records.questionEn: What do you usually do to spend a bit less money?
records.answerZh: 為了省錢，我中午都自己帶便當。週末也比較少出去吃大餐。
records.answerEn: To save money, I bring my own lunch box every day. I also go out for big meals less often on weekends.

records.questionZh: 這個週末你有什麼計畫嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you have any plans this weekend?
records.answerZh: 我還不確定，可能會去淡水走走。如果下雨的話，我就在家看電影。
records.answerEn: I'm not sure yet; I might go walk around Tamsui. If it rains, I'll stay home and watch movies.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有跟台灣人互相教對方語言的經驗？
records.questionEn: Have you ever taught languages to each other with a Taiwanese person?
records.answerZh: 有，我每個禮拜跟一個台灣朋友語言交換。我教她英文，她教我中文。
records.answerEn: Yes, every week I do a language exchange with a Taiwanese friend. I teach her English, and she teaches me Chinese.

records.questionZh: 要做重要決定的時候，你會先問誰的意見？
records.questionEn: When you have to make an important decision, whose opinion do you ask first?
records.answerZh: 我通常會先跟我太太商量。她想得比我仔細，常常給我很好的建議。
records.answerEn: I usually talk it over with my wife first. She thinks things through more carefully than I do and often gives me great advice.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣有沒有碰過什麼有趣或奇怪的事？
records.questionEn: Have you come across anything interesting or strange in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 有一次我在捷運上遇到一個阿伯，他一直用台語跟我聊天。我聽不懂，可是他還是很開心。
records.answerEn: Once on the MRT I ran into an older man who kept chatting with me in Taiwanese. I couldn't understand, but he was still very happy.

records.questionZh: 你最喜歡台灣人的哪一點？
records.questionEn: What do you like most about Taiwanese people?
records.answerZh: 我很欣賞台灣人的熱情，問路的時候大家都很願意幫忙。有時候還會直接帶我過去。
records.answerEn: I really appreciate how warm Taiwanese people are; when I ask for directions, everyone is happy to help. Sometimes they even take me there.

records.questionZh: 你平常都做什麼運動？
records.questionEn: What exercise do you usually do?
records.answerZh: 我每天早上都去河濱公園慢跑。跑完再去早餐店吃蛋餅，感覺很棒。
records.answerEn: I jog at the riverside park every morning. Afterward I go to a breakfast shop for an egg crepe, and it feels great.

records.questionZh: 你家走路到捷運站要多久？
records.questionEn: How long does it take to walk from your home to the MRT station?
records.answerZh: 很近，走路五分鐘以內就到了。所以我每天都可以睡晚一點。
records.answerEn: It's very close, within a five-minute walk. So I get to sleep in a bit every day.

records.questionZh: 你跟你的鄰居熟嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you know your neighbors well?
records.answerZh: 我跟隔壁的阿姨很熟。她常常煮太多菜，就拿一點來給我吃。
records.answerEn: I'm close with the lady next door. She often cooks too much and brings some over for me.

records.questionZh: 你常常需要寄錢回你的國家嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you often need to send money back to your country?
records.answerZh: 我每個月都會匯款給我爸媽。我都在網路銀行上弄，很方便。
records.answerEn: I wire money to my parents every month. I do it through online banking, which is very convenient.

records.questionZh: 買比較貴的東西時，你付完錢會記得拿什麼？
records.questionEn: When you buy something expensive, what do you remember to take after paying?
records.answerZh: 我會跟店家要收據，然後好好收起來。如果東西壞了，拿收據去修比較方便。
records.answerEn: I ask the shop for a receipt and keep it somewhere safe. If the item breaks, it's easier to get it repaired with the receipt.

records.questionZh: 你有收過一定要本人簽名才能拿的信嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you ever received a letter you had to sign for in person?
records.answerZh: 有，我上個月收到一封掛號信，是從銀行寄來的。郵差說要我本人簽名才能拿。
records.answerEn: Yes, last month I got a registered letter from the bank. The mail carrier said I had to sign for it myself.

records.questionZh: 你去銀行或郵局辦事的時候，第一件事做什麼？
records.questionEn: When you go to the bank or post office, what's the first thing you do?
records.answerZh: 我一進去就先抽號碼牌。然後坐在椅子上等，順便滑手機。
records.answerEn: As soon as I walk in, I take a queue number ticket. Then I sit and wait while scrolling on my phone.

records.questionZh: 在台灣辦電話門號或開銀行帳戶，需要帶什麼證件？
records.questionEn: What ID do you need to bring to get a phone number or open a bank account in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我需要帶居留證和護照。第一次辦的時候我忘了帶，只好再跑一趟。
records.answerEn: I need to bring my residence permit and passport. The first time, I forgot to bring them and had to make another trip.

records.questionZh: 你現在住在什麼樣的房子裡？
records.questionEn: What kind of place do you live in now?
records.answerZh: 我住在一棟二十幾層的大樓，我家在十八樓。晚上從陽台可以看到很漂亮的夜景。
records.answerEn: I live in a high-rise with over twenty floors, and my place is on the eighteenth. At night I can see a beautiful night view from the balcony.

records.questionZh: 你的衣服多嗎？都放在哪裡？
records.questionEn: Do you have a lot of clothes? Where do you keep them?
records.answerZh: 我的衣服太多了，衣櫃都快關不起來了。我想把一些不穿的送給朋友。
records.answerEn: I have way too many clothes; my wardrobe barely closes. I want to give some I don't wear to friends.

records.questionZh: 你的書或檔案多嗎？你怎麼整理？
records.questionEn: Do you have a lot of books or files? How do you organize them?
records.answerZh: 我的書很多，所以我會按照語言分類。中文書放一邊，英文書放另一邊。
records.answerEn: I have a lot of books, so I sort them by language. Chinese books go on one side and English books on the other.

records.questionZh: 你住的地方有沒有出過什麼問題？
records.questionEn: Has your place ever had any problems?
records.answerZh: 有，去年颱風的時候，我家天花板漏水。房東馬上找人來修，還好不太嚴重。
records.answerEn: Yes, during a typhoon last year, my ceiling leaked. The landlord got someone to fix it right away, and luckily it wasn't too serious.

records.questionZh: 你平常都去哪裡買菜？超市還是別的地方？
records.questionEn: Where do you usually buy groceries? The supermarket or somewhere else?
records.answerZh: 我比較喜歡去傳統市場買菜，又新鮮又便宜。老闆有時候還會多送我一把蔥。
records.answerEn: I prefer buying groceries at the traditional market; it's fresh and cheap. The vendors sometimes even throw in an extra bunch of green onions.

records.questionZh: 你常去的店，有沒有辦什麼卡可以打折？
records.questionEn: Do you have any cards for discounts at the stores you often go to?
records.answerZh: 我有辦藥妝店的會員，買東西可以累積點數。每次都可以省一點錢。
records.answerEn: I signed up for membership at a drugstore, so I collect points when I shop. I save a little money every time.

records.questionZh: 如果你網路上買的衣服不合身，你會怎麼辦？
records.questionEn: If clothes you bought online don't fit, what do you do?
records.answerZh: 我會直接退貨，大部分網站七天內都可以退。如果只是尺寸不對，我就會換一件。
records.answerEn: I just return them; most websites let you return within seven days. If it's only the wrong size, I'll exchange it.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有掉過東西？後來找回來了嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you ever lost something? Did you get it back?
records.answerZh: 有，我曾經把皮夾掉在公車上。後來去失物招領中心，真的找回來了！
records.answerEn: Yes, I once lost my wallet on a bus. Later I went to the lost and found center and actually got it back!

records.questionZh: 你睡覺的時候有什麼習慣？
records.questionEn: What habits do you have when you sleep?
records.answerZh: 我一定要用自己的枕頭才睡得著。所以出國旅行的時候，我常常睡不好。
records.answerEn: I can only fall asleep with my own pillow. So when I travel abroad, I often sleep badly.

records.questionZh: 下次放好幾天假的時候，你想去哪裡玩？
records.questionEn: Next time you have several days off, where do you want to go?
records.answerZh: 下次連假我想去台東，看看海邊的風景。不過連假人很多，要早一點訂房。
records.answerEn: On the next long weekend I want to go to Taitung to see the seaside scenery. But it's crowded on long weekends, so I need to book a room early.

records.questionZh: 你喝酒或熬夜以後，第二天通常會怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: After drinking or staying up late, how are you usually the next day?
records.answerZh: 我只要熬夜，隔天上班就一直打哈欠。所以我現在盡量十二點以前睡覺。
records.answerEn: Whenever I stay up late, I keep yawning at work the next day. So now I try to go to bed before midnight.

records.questionZh: 在台灣的餐廳吃飯，帳單上常有什麼額外的費用？
records.questionEn: When eating at restaurants in Taiwan, what extra charges often appear on the bill?
records.answerZh: 比較高級的餐廳通常會收一成服務費。所以在台灣吃飯不用另外給小費。
records.answerEn: Fancier restaurants usually add a ten percent service charge. So in Taiwan you don't need to leave a separate tip.

records.questionZh: 晚上肚子餓的時候，你最喜歡買什麼宵夜？
records.questionEn: When you're hungry at night, what late-night snack do you like to buy most?
records.answerZh: 我最喜歡買鹹酥雞，再加一點九層塔和辣椒。配一杯冰紅茶真的很過癮。
records.answerEn: My favorite is Taiwanese popcorn chicken with some basil and chili. With a cup of iced black tea, it's so satisfying.

records.questionZh: 你一個禮拜喝幾杯飲料店的飲料？
records.questionEn: How many drinks from drink stands do you have a week?
records.answerZh: 我幾乎每天都喝一杯手搖飲，最愛珍珠奶茶。我都點半糖少冰，比較健康一點。
records.answerEn: I have a shaken drink almost every day, and my favorite is bubble milk tea. I always order half sugar and less ice to be a bit healthier.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣哪一種食物吃太多會不舒服？
records.questionEn: Which Taiwanese food makes you feel bad if you eat too much?
records.answerZh: 我覺得炸的東西太油膩了，像炸雞排。吃完我常常要喝很多綠茶。
records.answerEn: I think fried food is too greasy, like fried chicken cutlets. After eating it I often need to drink a lot of green tea.

records.questionZh: 你身邊有朋友不吃肉嗎？他們都吃什麼？
records.questionEn: Do you have friends who don't eat meat? What do they eat?
records.answerZh: 我有一個同事吃素，她常常帶我去素食自助餐。我發現素食也可以很好吃。
records.answerEn: I have a coworker who's vegetarian, and she often takes me to a vegetarian buffet. I've found that vegetarian food can be really tasty too.

records.questionZh: 坐捷運的時候，你通常站在哪裡等車？
records.questionEn: When you take the MRT, where do you usually stand to wait for the train?
records.answerZh: 我通常會走到最後一節車廂，因為人比較少。有時候還找得到位子坐。
records.answerEn: I usually walk to the last car because there are fewer people. Sometimes I can even find a seat.

records.questionZh: 連假的時候，火車站或機場人多嗎？
records.questionEn: Are train stations and airports crowded during long weekends?
records.answerZh: 人超多的，到處都是拉著行李的旅客。所以我連假都盡量不出遠門。
records.answerEn: Super crowded, with travelers pulling luggage everywhere. So I try not to travel far on long weekends.

records.questionZh: 你上次坐飛機有遇到什麼問題嗎？
records.questionEn: Did you run into any problems the last time you flew?
records.answerZh: 上次因為颱風，我的班機延誤了五個小時。我只好在機場吃東西、看書等。
records.answerEn: Last time my flight was delayed five hours because of a typhoon. I had no choice but to eat and read at the airport while I waited.

records.questionZh: 你每次入境台灣的時候，會很緊張嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you get nervous every time you enter Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 不會，海關的人員都很客氣。只要證件準備好，很快就可以出去了。
records.answerEn: No, the customs officers are very polite. As long as your documents are ready, you can get out quickly.

records.questionZh: 你覺得晚上去哪裡看城市最漂亮？
records.questionEn: Where do you think is the most beautiful place to see the city at night?
records.answerZh: 我覺得象山的夜景最漂亮，可以看到整個台北。爬上去有點累，可是很值得。
records.answerEn: I think the night view from Elephant Mountain is the most beautiful; you can see all of Taipei. Climbing up is a bit tiring, but it's worth it.

records.questionZh: 放假的時候，你喜歡去戶外走走嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you like getting outdoors on your days off?
records.answerZh: 我很喜歡登山，台灣的山真的很漂亮。不過每次都要先看天氣，才不會遇到下雨。
records.answerEn: I love hiking in the mountains; Taiwan's mountains are really beautiful. But I always have to check the weather first so I don't get caught in the rain.

records.questionZh: 開車或騎車去不熟的地方，你怎麼找路？
records.questionEn: When you drive or ride to an unfamiliar place, how do you find your way?
records.answerZh: 我都用手機導航，非常方便。不過有一次它帶我走到一條很小的路，我差點迷路。
records.answerEn: I always use navigation on my phone; it's very convenient. But once it took me down a really narrow road, and I almost got lost.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣有騎機車或開車嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you ride a scooter or drive in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我有騎機車，去年考到台灣的駕照。我考了兩次才過，路考的時候太緊張了。
records.answerEn: I ride a scooter; I got my Taiwanese driver's license last year. It took me two tries to pass because I was too nervous during the road test.

records.questionZh: 出去旅行的時候，你喜歡先計畫好，還是隨便走走？
records.questionEn: When you travel, do you like to plan ahead or just wander around?
records.answerZh: 我喜歡先把行程排好，這樣比較不會浪費時間。不過我也會留一天自由活動。
records.answerEn: I like to plan my itinerary first so I don't waste time. But I also leave one day free.

records.questionZh: 你覺得九份或淡水這種地方，什麼時候去最好？
records.questionEn: When do you think is the best time to go to places like Jiufen or Tamsui?
records.answerZh: 我覺得平日去最好，因為週末遊客太多了。走在老街上連拍照都很難。
records.answerEn: I think weekdays are best because there are too many visitors on weekends. Walking down the old street, it's hard to even take photos.

records.questionZh: 你出門的時候，常常忘記帶傘嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you often forget to bring an umbrella when you go out?
records.answerZh: 常常忘記，所以我常淋雨回家。上禮拜還因為這樣感冒了。
records.answerEn: I forget all the time, so I often get caught in the rain on my way home. Last week I even caught a cold because of it.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有不小心受過傷？怎麼處理的？
records.questionEn: Have you ever hurt yourself by accident? How did you deal with it?
records.answerZh: 我上次切菜不小心切到手，傷口流了很多血。我馬上去藥局買藥來擦。
records.answerEn: Last time I accidentally cut my hand while chopping vegetables, and the cut bled a lot. I went right to the pharmacy to buy some ointment.

records.questionZh: 你覺得在台灣看醫生貴嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think seeing a doctor in Taiwan is expensive?
records.answerZh: 不貴，因為我有健保，掛號費只要一點點錢。我另外也買了意外保險，比較安心。
records.answerEn: Not expensive, because I have national health insurance and the registration fee is very low. I also bought accident insurance, which gives me peace of mind.

records.questionZh: 如果你覺得自己好像發燒了，你會怎麼做？
records.questionEn: If you feel like you might have a fever, what do you do?
records.answerZh: 我會先量一下體溫，如果超過三十八度，就去看醫生。然後多喝水、好好休息。
records.answerEn: I first take my temperature, and if it's over thirty-eight degrees, I go see a doctor. Then I drink lots of water and get good rest.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有住過醫院？是為了什麼？
records.questionEn: Have you ever been in the hospital? What for?
records.answerZh: 我小時候因為盲腸炎開刀，住了一個禮拜的醫院。那是我唯一一次住院。
records.answerEn: When I was little I had surgery for appendicitis and stayed in the hospital for a week. That's the only time I've been hospitalized.

records.questionZh: 太久沒吃東西或太熱的時候，你會覺得怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: How do you feel when you haven't eaten for too long or it's too hot?
records.answerZh: 我會覺得頭暈，有時候還會想吐。所以夏天出門我一定會帶水和一點餅乾。
records.answerEn: I feel dizzy, and sometimes I even feel like throwing up. So in summer I always bring water and some crackers when I go out.

records.questionZh: 台灣的天氣對你的身體有什麼影響？
records.questionEn: How does Taiwan's weather affect your body?
records.answerZh: 台灣很潮濕，我的皮膚變得比較好。可是夏天太陽很大，不擦防曬很容易曬傷。
records.answerEn: Taiwan is humid, so my skin has gotten better. But the summer sun is strong, and without sunscreen it's easy to get sunburned.

records.questionZh: 天氣變冷的時候，你怎麼讓自己不要感冒？
records.questionEn: When the weather turns cold, how do you keep from catching a cold?
records.answerZh: 為了預防感冒，我每天都會多喝熱水。出門也一定穿外套、戴口罩。
records.answerEn: To prevent colds, I drink lots of hot water every day. I also always wear a jacket and a mask when I go out.

records.questionZh: 你晚上睡得好嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you sleep well at night?
records.answerZh: 最近工作壓力很大，我常常失眠。躺在床上兩三個小時都睡不著。
records.answerEn: Work has been really stressful lately, and I often can't sleep. I lie in bed for two or three hours without falling asleep.

records.questionZh: 你現在做什麼工作？你喜歡嗎？
records.questionEn: What do you do for work now? Do you like it?
records.answerZh: 我的職業是工程師，在一家科技公司上班。工作很忙，可是我學到很多東西。
records.answerEn: I'm an engineer by profession and work at a tech company. The work is busy, but I've learned a lot.

records.questionZh: 你是怎麼找到現在這份工作的？
records.questionEn: How did you find your current job?
records.answerZh: 我在網路上看到這家公司在找人，就去應徵了。面試了兩次才錄取。
records.answerEn: I saw online that this company was hiring, so I applied. I had two interviews before they hired me.

records.questionZh: 你大學畢業以前，有在公司工作過嗎？
records.questionEn: Did you work at a company before you graduated from college?
records.answerZh: 有，我大四的時候在一家旅行社實習三個月。我學到怎麼跟客人溝通。
records.answerEn: Yes, in my senior year I interned at a travel agency for three months. I learned how to communicate with customers.

records.questionZh: 你第一天上班的時候，主管讓你做什麼？
records.questionEn: On your first day at work, what did your supervisor have you do?
records.answerZh: 主管給我的第一個任務是整理客人的資料。雖然很簡單，可是我做得很認真。
records.answerEn: The first task my supervisor gave me was organizing customer information. It was simple, but I did it very carefully.

records.questionZh: 你的電腦裡最多的是什麼東西？
records.questionEn: What is there most of on your computer?
records.answerZh: 我的電腦裡最多的是照片和工作的檔案。我每個月都會備份一次，怕電腦壞掉。
records.answerEn: What I have most on my computer is photos and work files. I back them up once a month in case my computer breaks.

records.questionZh: 開會的時候，你需要上台報告嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you need to give presentations in meetings?
records.answerZh: 需要，我每個月都要做一次簡報。前一天晚上我都會在家練習好幾次。
records.answerEn: Yes, I have to give a presentation once a month. The night before, I always practice several times at home.

records.questionZh: 你家附近的店，晚上大概開到幾點？
records.questionEn: Until about what time are the shops near your home open at night?
records.answerZh: 便利商店是二十四小時營業的。其他的小吃店大部分九點就關了。
records.answerEn: The convenience stores are open twenty-four hours. Most of the other small eateries close at nine.

records.questionZh: 你念書的時候，學費是自己付的嗎？
records.questionEn: When you were studying, did you pay your own tuition?
records.answerZh: 不是，我拿到學校的獎學金，學費和生活費都不用擔心。所以我很認真念書。
