records.answerEn: No, I got a scholarship from the school, so I didn't have to worry about tuition or living expenses. So I studied really hard.

records.questionZh: 你小時候放學以後，還要去上別的課嗎？
records.questionEn: When you were a kid, did you have to take other classes after school?
records.answerZh: 我國中的時候每天都去補習班補數學。常常晚上九點才回家，好累。
records.answerEn: In junior high I went to cram school for math every day. I often didn't get home until nine at night, which was exhausting.

records.questionZh: 你覺得現在找工作，最重要的是什麼能力？
records.questionEn: What do you think is the most important ability for finding a job these days?
records.answerZh: 我覺得要有一種專業的技術，像是寫程式或設計。會說好幾種語言也很有幫助。
records.answerEn: I think you need a professional skill, like programming or design. Speaking several languages also helps a lot.

records.questionZh: 你剛來台灣時，有什麼事讓你覺得很意外？
records.questionEn: When you first came to Taiwan, what surprised you?
records.answerZh: 我很驚訝垃圾車會放音樂。大家聽到音樂就拿著垃圾出來等。
records.answerEn: I was amazed that garbage trucks play music. When people hear the music, they come out with their trash and wait.

records.questionZh: 你覺得一個人晚上在台灣走路安全嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think it's safe to walk alone at night in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我覺得很安全，晚上一個人走路也很安心。到處都有便利商店，有問題可以進去。
records.answerEn: I think it's very safe, and I feel at ease walking alone at night. There are convenience stores everywhere, so you can go in if there's a problem.

records.questionZh: 如果好朋友對你說謊，你會怎麼做？
records.questionEn: If a good friend lied to you, what would you do?
records.answerZh: 我會很生氣，可是如果他真心道歉，我還是會原諒他。朋友之間難免會犯錯。
records.answerEn: I'd be angry, but if he sincerely apologized, I'd still forgive him. Mistakes are bound to happen between friends.

records.questionZh: 在人多的聚會上，你通常會主動跟別人聊天嗎？
records.questionEn: At crowded gatherings, do you usually start conversations with people?
records.answerZh: 不太會，我比較內向，常常一個人在旁邊吃東西。熟了以後我就很愛說話了。
records.answerEn: Not really; I'm rather introverted and often eat by myself off to the side. Once I get to know people, I love to talk.

records.questionZh: 你的另一半或好朋友，有什麼讓你很感動的地方？
records.questionEn: What about your partner or a close friend really touches you?
records.answerZh: 我男朋友很體貼，下雨天會騎車來接我下班。我生病的時候，他還會煮粥給我吃。
records.answerEn: My boyfriend is very considerate; on rainy days he rides over to pick me up from work. When I'm sick, he even makes me porridge.

records.questionZh: 你最不喜歡跟什麼樣的人一起工作？
records.questionEn: What kind of people do you least like working with?
records.answerZh: 我最不喜歡自私的人，他們只想到自己。團體報告的時候，他們常常什麼都不做。
records.answerEn: I least like selfish people; they only think of themselves. On group projects, they often do nothing at all.

records.questionZh: 你覺得當老師最需要什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you think a teacher needs most?
records.answerZh: 我覺得最需要耐心，因為學生常常問一樣的問題。我的中文老師就很有耐心。
records.answerEn: I think they need patience most, because students often ask the same questions. My Chinese teacher is very patient.

records.questionZh: 你第一次去夜市的時候，最想試什麼？
records.questionEn: The first time you went to a night market, what did you most want to try?
records.answerZh: 我對臭豆腐很好奇，因為聞起來好臭。吃了以後才發現其實很好吃！
records.answerEn: I was curious about stinky tofu because it smelled so bad. After eating it, I found out it's actually delicious!

records.questionZh: 你會把家裡的鑰匙交給誰？
records.questionEn: Who would you give your house keys to?
records.answerZh: 我只會交給我最信任的朋友。我們認識十年了，她從來沒讓我失望過。
records.answerEn: Only to the friend I trust most. We've known each other for ten years, and she's never let me down.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣的店員對客人怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: How do you think shop clerks in Taiwan treat customers?
records.answerZh: 我覺得他們很親切，總是帶著微笑說「歡迎光臨」。讓人覺得很舒服。
records.answerEn: I think they're very friendly and always say welcome with a smile. It makes you feel comfortable.

records.questionZh: 你跟你的另一半在一起多久了？
records.questionEn: How long have you been with your partner?
records.answerZh: 我們交往三年了，是在語言交換的時候認識的。我們打算明年結婚。
records.answerEn: We've been dating for three years; we met through a language exchange. We plan to get married next year.

records.questionZh: 你覺得生活中最重要的是什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you think is most important in life?
records.answerZh: 我覺得最重要的是家人和朋友，要好好珍惜。因為住在國外，我更懂得這一點。
records.answerEn: I think the most important things are family and friends, and you should cherish them. Living abroad, I understand this even better.

records.questionZh: 你覺得學中文一定要學寫字嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think you have to learn to write characters when learning Chinese?
records.answerZh: 我覺得有必要，因為會寫字比較容易記住。不過我覺得會打字也很重要。
records.answerEn: I think it's necessary, because writing characters makes them easier to remember. But I think being able to type is important too.

records.questionZh: 你覺得去面試的時候應該穿什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you think you should wear to a job interview?
records.answerZh: 我覺得穿襯衫和西裝褲比較合適。穿得太隨便，會讓人覺得你不認真。
records.answerEn: I think a shirt and dress pants are more appropriate. If you dress too casually, people will think you're not serious.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣的早餐店怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: What do you think of Taiwan's breakfast shops?
records.answerZh: 台灣的早餐很豐富，有蛋餅、三明治、蘿蔔糕。我每天都吃不一樣的。
records.answerEn: Breakfast in Taiwan is so plentiful: egg crepes, sandwiches, turnip cakes. I eat something different every day.

records.questionZh: 你的同學或同事當中，有讓你很佩服的人嗎？
records.questionEn: Among your classmates or coworkers, is there anyone you really admire?
records.answerZh: 有，我的同事小林非常優秀，會說四種語言。工作上遇到問題，大家都會去問他。
records.answerEn: Yes, my coworker Xiao Lin is outstanding and speaks four languages. When anyone has a problem at work, they go ask him.

records.questionZh: 你喜歡一個人住，還是跟家人一起住？
records.questionEn: Do you prefer living alone or with your family?
records.answerZh: 我喜歡一個人住，因為比較自由。想幾點回家都可以，也不用跟別人搶浴室。
records.answerEn: I like living alone because I have more freedom. I can come home whenever I want and don't have to fight anyone for the bathroom.

records.questionZh: 朋友第一次來你家，你怎麼跟他說怎麼走？
records.questionEn: When a friend visits your home for the first time, how do you tell them how to get there?
records.answerZh: 我會傳一張很詳細的地圖給他，告訴他從哪個出口出來。這樣他就不會迷路了。
records.answerEn: I send them a very detailed map and tell them which exit to take. That way they won't get lost.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣哪個地方一定要去看看？
records.questionEn: Which place in Taiwan do you think is a must-see?
records.answerZh: 我覺得阿里山很值得去，可以看日出。雖然要很早起床，可是真的很美。
records.answerEn: I think Alishan is really worth going to; you can watch the sunrise. You have to get up really early, but it's truly beautiful.

records.questionZh: 你週末都在做什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you do on weekends?
records.answerZh: 我大部分的週末都待在家裡休息。偶爾會跟朋友去咖啡廳聊天。
records.answerEn: Most weekends I stay home and rest. Once in a while I go chat with friends at a café.

records.questionZh: 你辦簽證的時候順利嗎？
records.questionEn: Did getting your visa go smoothly?
records.answerZh: 過程有一點麻煩，要準備很多文件。不過辦事的人很有耐心，一步一步教我。
records.answerEn: The process was a bit of a hassle, and I had to prepare a lot of documents. But the staff were very patient and walked me through it step by step.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣和你的國家，規定上有什麼不一樣？
records.questionEn: What differences in rules are there between Taiwan and your country?
records.answerZh: 台灣的法律規定騎機車一定要戴安全帽。在我的國家，很多人騎車都不戴。
records.answerEn: Taiwan's law requires you to wear a helmet when riding a scooter. In my country, a lot of people don't wear one.

records.questionZh: 台灣有什麼過節的方式讓你覺得很特別？
records.questionEn: What way of celebrating holidays in Taiwan do you find special?
records.answerZh: 我覺得過年發紅包的習俗很有意思。結婚以後，就要開始給家裡的小朋友紅包了。
records.answerEn: I find the custom of giving red envelopes at New Year really interesting. After you get married, you have to start giving red envelopes to the kids in the family.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣的東西貴不貴？
records.questionEn: Do you think things in Taiwan are expensive?
records.answerZh: 我覺得吃的東西價格不貴，可是房租很貴。在台北租房子真的不容易。
records.answerEn: I think food prices aren't high, but rent is expensive. Renting a place in Taipei really isn't easy.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台北和台南的生活有什麼不一樣？
records.questionEn: How do you think life in Taipei and Tainan differs?
records.answerZh: 我覺得差別很大，台北比較忙，台南比較悠閒。台南的小吃也比台北便宜。
records.answerEn: I think there's a big difference: Taipei is busier and Tainan is more relaxed. Street food in Tainan is also cheaper than in Taipei.

records.questionZh: 你小時候想當什麼？現在呢？
records.questionEn: What did you want to be as a kid? And now?
records.answerZh: 我小時候的理想是當太空人。現在我只希望可以開一家小咖啡廳。
records.answerEn: As a kid, my dream was to be an astronaut. Now I just hope I can open a small café.

records.questionZh: 你在網路上買東西，有遇過什麼問題嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you ever had any problems shopping online?
records.answerZh: 有一次我買了十個杯子，可是數量不對，只寄來八個。我馬上聯絡賣家，他們很快就補寄了。
records.answerEn: Once I bought ten cups, but the quantity was wrong and only eight arrived. I contacted the seller right away, and they quickly sent the rest.

records.questionZh: 坐捷運或火車的時候，你怎麼知道快到站了？
records.questionEn: When you're on the MRT or train, how do you know your stop is coming up?
records.answerZh: 我會注意聽車上的廣播，有中文、台語和英文。可是車上太吵的話，我還是會坐過站。
records.answerEn: I listen carefully to the announcements on board, which are in Mandarin, Taiwanese, and English. But if it's too noisy, I still miss my stop.

records.questionZh: 你試過哪些學中文的方法？哪個最有用？
records.questionEn: What methods of learning Chinese have you tried? Which was most useful?
records.answerZh: 我試過看影集和用單字卡。我覺得跟台灣朋友聊天的效果最好。
records.answerEn: I've tried watching series and using flashcards. I think chatting with Taiwanese friends gives the best results.

records.questionZh: 你有在健身或控制飲食嗎？為什麼？
records.questionEn: Do you work out or watch your diet? Why?
records.answerZh: 有，我每週去健身房三次，想保持好身材。可是晚上看到鹹酥雞還是忍不住。
records.answerEn: Yes, I go to the gym three times a week because I want to stay in good shape. But when I see popcorn chicken at night, I still can't resist.

records.questionZh: 你覺得怎麼樣能讓中文進步得更快？
records.questionEn: How do you think you can make your Chinese improve faster?
records.answerZh: 我覺得要多說多聽，才能提高中文程度。所以我常常去早餐店跟老闆聊天。
records.answerEn: I think you have to speak and listen a lot to raise your Chinese level. So I often chat with the owner at the breakfast shop.

records.questionZh: 你覺得自己還要多久才能用中文看新聞？
records.questionEn: How much longer do you think it'll be before you can read the news in Chinese?
records.answerZh: 我估計還要兩三年吧。新聞裡有很多難的字，我現在只看得懂標題。
records.answerEn: I'd estimate another two or three years. The news has a lot of difficult words, and right now I can only understand the headlines.

records.questionZh: 你跟家人視訊的時候，都聊些什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you talk about when you video-call your family?
records.answerZh: 我常常提到台灣的食物，他們聽了都很羨慕。我媽媽說明年一定要來台灣玩。
records.answerEn: I often mention Taiwanese food, and they're all envious when they hear about it. My mom says she's definitely coming to Taiwan next year.

records.questionZh: 你們公司最近在忙什麼大事嗎？
records.questionEn: Is your company busy with anything big lately?
records.answerZh: 我們公司正在進行一個新的計畫，要開發一個新產品。所以最近大家都在加班。
records.answerEn: My company is carrying out a new project to develop a new product. So everyone's been working overtime lately.

records.questionZh: 在你的國家，第一次見面時大家怎麼打招呼？
records.questionEn: In your country, how do people greet each other when they first meet?
records.answerZh: 在我的國家，第一次見面通常會握手。熟一點的朋友就會擁抱。
records.answerEn: In my country, people usually shake hands when they first meet. Closer friends will hug.

records.questionZh: 你最不喜歡在哪裡排隊？
records.questionEn: Where do you least like waiting in line?
records.answerZh: 我最不喜歡在醫院排隊，等待的時間常常超過一個小時。所以我都先上網掛號。
records.answerEn: I least like waiting in line at the hospital; the wait is often more than an hour. So I always register online first.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣的學生跟你國家的學生有什麼不一樣？
records.questionEn: How do you think Taiwanese students differ from students in your country?
records.answerZh: 我覺得台灣的教育很重視考試，學生壓力很大。很多小朋友放學以後還要去補習。
records.answerEn: I think education in Taiwan puts a lot of emphasis on exams, and students are under a lot of pressure. Many kids still go to cram school after school.

records.questionZh: 你在做決定的時候，是很快就決定的人嗎？
records.questionEn: When making decisions, are you someone who decides quickly?
records.answerZh: 不是，我常常很猶豫。連在飲料店點飲料都要想好久，後面的人都在等我。
records.answerEn: No, I often hesitate a lot. Even ordering at a drink stand takes me forever, and the people behind me are all waiting.

records.questionZh: 你上課或上班的時候，常常請假嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you often take time off from class or work?
records.answerZh: 很少，我上學期只缺席過一次，因為發燒了。老師還傳訊息關心我。
records.answerEn: Rarely. Last semester I was absent only once, because I had a fever. My teacher even sent me a message to check on me.

records.questionZh: 你知道在台灣做哪些事會被罰錢嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you know what things you can get fined for in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我知道在捷運上吃東西會被罰款。還有亂丟垃圾也會被罰錢。
records.answerEn: I know you'll get fined for eating on the MRT. Littering will also get you fined.

records.questionZh: 你下班以後都做什麼放鬆？
records.questionEn: What do you do to relax after work?
records.answerZh: 我的休閒活動是打籃球和看電影。週末有時候也會去河邊騎腳踏車。
records.answerEn: My leisure activities are playing basketball and watching movies. On weekends I sometimes go biking along the river too.

records.questionZh: 你學過的中文字裡，哪一個最難寫？
records.questionEn: Of the Chinese characters you've learned, which is the hardest to write?
records.answerZh: 我學過的字當中，「鬱」最難寫。我練習了很多次，還是常常寫錯。
records.answerEn: Among the characters I've learned, the one for melancholy is the hardest to write. I've practiced it many times and still often get it wrong.

records.questionZh: 如果你在路上看到有人發生車禍，你會怎麼做？
records.questionEn: If you saw someone in a traffic accident on the street, what would you do?
records.answerZh: 我會馬上報警，也會叫救護車。然後看看有沒有人需要幫忙。
records.answerEn: I'd call the police right away and also call an ambulance. Then I'd check whether anyone needed help.

records.questionZh: 你家有沒有準備滅火器？為什麼？
records.questionEn: Do you have a fire extinguisher at home? Why?
records.answerZh: 有，我們大樓每層都有滅火器。房東說這樣發生火災的時候才能馬上處理。
records.answerEn: Yes, every floor of our building has a fire extinguisher. The landlord says that way we can deal with it right away if there's a fire.

records.questionZh: 你覺得學校應該讓學生帶手機嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think schools should let students bring phones?
records.answerZh: 我贊成讓學生帶手機，有事情可以聯絡家人。可是上課的時候應該要收起來。
records.answerEn: I'm in favor of letting students bring phones so they can contact family if something comes up. But they should put them away during class.

records.questionZh: 你覺得住在台灣，哪些地方最好？
records.questionEn: What do you think is best about living in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 在交通方面，台灣非常方便，捷運和公車很多。在吃的方面，選擇也很多。
records.answerEn: In terms of transportation, Taiwan is very convenient, with lots of MRT lines and buses. In terms of food, there are lots of choices too.

records.questionZh: 你覺得你現在的房租貴不貴？
records.questionEn: Do you think your current rent is expensive?
records.answerZh: 我覺得還算合理，一個月一萬兩千塊，離捷運站也很近。房東人也很好。
records.answerEn: I think it's fairly reasonable: twelve thousand a month, and it's close to the MRT station. The landlord is nice too.

records.questionZh: 朋友心情不好的時候，你會做什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you do when a friend is feeling down?
records.answerZh: 我會請他吃東西，聽他說話，好好安慰他。有時候陪著他就夠了。
records.answerEn: I treat them to some food, listen to them, and comfort them. Sometimes just being there with them is enough.

records.questionZh: 你覺得在工作上，什麼樣的態度最重要？
records.questionEn: What attitude do you think matters most at work?
records.answerZh: 我覺得要很積極，遇到問題要主動想辦法。老闆比較喜歡這樣的員工。
records.answerEn: I think you need to be proactive and find solutions on your own when problems come up. Bosses prefer employees like that.

records.questionZh: 你在公司裡負責什麼工作？
records.questionEn: What are you responsible for at your company?
records.answerZh: 我的職位是業務經理，負責跟國外的客戶聯絡。常常要出差，有點辛苦。
records.answerEn: My position is sales manager, and I'm in charge of contacting overseas clients. I often have to travel for work, which is a bit tiring.

records.questionZh: 你覺得什麼時候可以跟老闆談薪水的事？
records.questionEn: When do you think it's okay to talk to your boss about salary?
records.answerZh: 我覺得做滿一年，表現也不錯的話，就可以要求加薪。不過要先準備好自己的成績。
records.answerEn: I think once you've worked a full year and performed well, you can ask for a raise. But you should have your results ready first.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣生活，覺得最困難的是什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you find hardest about living in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 對我來說，最大的挑戰是看懂中文的信件和合約。我常常要請台灣朋友幫我看。
records.answerEn: For me, the biggest challenge is understanding letters and contracts in Chinese. I often have to ask Taiwanese friends to read them for me.

records.questionZh: 你住的地方安靜嗎？
records.questionEn: Is where you live quiet?
records.answerZh: 不太安靜，樓下就是大馬路，噪音很大。晚上機車的聲音常常吵得我睡不著。
records.answerEn: Not really; there's a big road right downstairs and the noise is loud. At night the sound of scooters often keeps me awake.

records.questionZh: 你搬家的時候，最需要買什麼東西？
records.questionEn: When you moved, what did you most need to buy?
records.answerZh: 我最需要買家電，像是冰箱和洗衣機。我後來在網路上買二手的，省了不少錢。
records.answerEn: I most needed to buy home appliances, like a fridge and a washing machine. I ended up buying secondhand ones online and saved a lot of money.

records.questionZh: 你的手機沒電的時候，你會去哪裡充電？
records.questionEn: When your phone runs out of battery, where do you go to charge it?
records.answerZh: 我會去咖啡廳，找有插座的位置坐。有些咖啡廳每個座位旁邊都有。
records.answerEn: I go to a café and find a seat with an outlet. Some cafés have one next to every seat.

records.questionZh: 台灣夏天的時候，你家最常出現什麼討厭的東西？
records.questionEn: During Taiwan's summer, what annoying thing shows up most often in your home?
records.answerZh: 最常出現的就是蟑螂，有時候還會飛！我每次看到都會大叫。
records.answerEn: Cockroaches show up the most, and sometimes they even fly! I scream every time I see one.

records.questionZh: 你騎車或開車有被警察攔下來過嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you ever been pulled over by the police while riding or driving?
records.answerZh: 有，我曾經因為違規左轉被開了一張罰單。罰了六百塊，我現在都乖乖兩段式左轉。
records.answerEn: Yes, I once got a ticket for an illegal left turn. It was a six-hundred-dollar fine, so now I always do the two-stage left turn like I'm supposed to.

records.questionZh: 你的家鄉是大城市還是小地方？
records.questionEn: Is your hometown a big city or a small place?
records.answerZh: 我的家鄉是一個小鎮，人口只有五千多人。跟台北比起來，安靜多了。
records.answerEn: My hometown is a small town with a population of just over five thousand. Compared to Taipei, it's much quieter.

records.questionZh: 台灣投票的時候，你注意到什麼特別的事？
records.questionEn: What special things have you noticed when Taiwan holds a vote?
records.answerZh: 選舉前街上到處都是宣傳車，聲音很大。很多人還會特地回家鄉投票。
records.answerEn: Before an election there are campaign vans all over the streets, and they're really loud. Many people even make a special trip back to their hometowns to vote.

records.questionZh: 你覺得一個城市的領導人最重要的工作是什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you think is the most important job of a city's leader?
records.answerZh: 我覺得市長最重要的工作是把交通弄好。還要多蓋一些公園，讓大家有地方運動。
records.answerEn: I think a mayor's most important job is getting traffic sorted out. They should also build more parks so people have places to exercise.

records.questionZh: 你以後想在台灣買房子嗎？
records.questionEn: Would you like to buy a home in Taiwan someday?
records.answerZh: 我很想，可是台北的房價太高了。我可能會考慮住在台北附近的城市。
records.answerEn: I'd love to, but housing prices in Taipei are too high. I might consider living in a city near Taipei.

records.questionZh: 你每個月會把一部分薪水存起來嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you save part of your salary every month?
records.answerZh: 會，我每個月存三分之一的薪水。我希望存款夠了以後，可以去歐洲旅行。
records.answerEn: Yes, I save a third of my salary every month. Once I have enough savings, I hope to travel to Europe.

records.questionZh: 如果可以許一個願望給全世界，你會許什麼？
records.questionEn: If you could make one wish for the whole world, what would it be?
records.answerZh: 我希望世界和平，大家都不要再打仗了。每個人都能平平安安地過日子。
records.answerEn: I'd wish for world peace, with no more wars. Everyone could live their lives safe and sound.

records.questionZh: 你覺得你住的地區安全嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think the area you live in is safe?
records.answerZh: 我覺得這裡的治安很好，晚上出門也不用擔心。就算把手機忘在咖啡廳，常常也找得回來。
records.answerEn: I think public security here is very good, and I don't worry going out at night. Even if you leave your phone at a café, you can often get it back.

records.questionZh: 除夕晚上，你通常跟誰一起吃飯？
records.questionEn: Who do you usually eat with on Lunar New Year's Eve?
records.answerZh: 去年我在朋友家吃年夜飯，菜多得吃不完。他們家一定會有一整條魚，代表年年有餘。
records.answerEn: Last year I had New Year's Eve dinner at a friend's home, and there was more food than we could finish. Their family always has a whole fish, which stands for abundance every year.

records.questionZh: 冬至或元宵節的時候，台灣人會吃什麼？
records.questionEn: What do Taiwanese people eat on the Winter Solstice or the Lantern Festival?
records.answerZh: 台灣人會吃湯圓，我最喜歡芝麻口味的。冬天吃一碗熱熱的，很溫暖。
records.answerEn: Taiwanese people eat sweet rice balls, and my favorite is the sesame kind. Eating a hot bowl in winter is so warming.

records.questionZh: 端午節的時候，你通常會做什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you usually do during the Dragon Boat Festival?
records.answerZh: 我會去河邊看比賽，今年還跟同事一起划龍舟。雖然很累，可是非常好玩。
records.answerEn: I go to the riverside to watch the races, and this year I even rowed a dragon boat with my coworkers. It was tiring, but so much fun.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣看過什麼熱鬧的傳統活動？
records.questionEn: What lively traditional events have you seen in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我看過一次廟會，有很多人在表演，還放了好多鞭炮。整條街都好熱鬧。
records.answerEn: I once saw a temple fair with lots of performers, and they set off tons of firecrackers. The whole street was so lively.

records.questionZh: 過年的時候，你的台灣朋友家會拜拜嗎？
records.questionEn: Does your Taiwanese friend's family make offerings during Lunar New Year?
records.answerZh: 會，他們家過年會準備很多菜拜祖先。拜完以後，大家再一起吃。
records.answerEn: Yes, at New Year their family prepares lots of dishes as offerings to their ancestors. Afterward, everyone eats together.

records.questionZh: 過年前，台灣人會在門上貼什麼？
records.questionEn: Before Lunar New Year, what do Taiwanese people put up on their doors?
records.answerZh: 他們會在門上貼紅色的春聯。我今年也買了一副，貼在我家門口。
records.answerEn: They put up red Spring Festival couplets on their doors. This year I bought a set too and put it up at my front door.

records.questionZh: 你知道今年的中秋節是幾月幾號嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you know what date the Mid-Autumn Festival is this year?
records.answerZh: 我不太確定，因為中秋節是看農曆的。每年的日期都不一樣，我都要查手機。
records.answerEn: I'm not sure, because the Mid-Autumn Festival follows the lunar calendar. The date is different every year, so I always have to check my phone.

records.questionZh: 你手機裡最常用的是什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you use most on your phone?
records.answerZh: 我最常用的應用程式是地圖和外送的。下雨天不想出門，我就直接叫外送。
records.answerEn: The apps I use most are maps and food delivery. On rainy days when I don't want to go out, I just order delivery.

records.questionZh: 你第一次用新的網站買東西，要先做什麼？
records.questionEn: The first time you shop on a new website, what do you have to do first?
records.answerZh: 通常要先註冊一個帳號，填姓名和電話。有些網站註冊還可以拿到折價券。
records.answerEn: Usually you have to register an account first and fill in your name and phone number. Some websites even give you a coupon for signing up.

records.questionZh: 你看到朋友在網路上分享照片，通常會怎麼做？
records.questionEn: When you see friends share photos online, what do you usually do?
records.answerZh: 我通常會按讚，有時候也會留言。如果照片很好笑，我還會分享給別人。
records.answerEn: I usually give it a like, and sometimes I leave a comment. If the photo is funny, I'll share it with others too.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有在網路上看過即時的比賽或表演？
records.questionEn: Have you ever watched a game or performance online in real time?
records.answerZh: 有，我常常在網路上看籃球比賽的直播。有時候還會跟朋友一邊看一邊聊天。
records.answerEn: Yes, I often watch livestreams of basketball games online. Sometimes I chat with friends while watching.

records.questionZh: 你在家看影片的時候，通常用什麼看？
records.questionEn: What do you usually use to watch videos at home?
records.answerZh: 我通常用平板看，因為螢幕比手機大。晚上躺在床上看很舒服。
records.answerEn: I usually watch on my tablet because the screen is bigger than my phone's. It's comfortable to watch lying in bed at night.

records.questionZh: 你找到一個很好笑的影片，會怎麼分享給朋友？
records.questionEn: If you find a really funny video, how do you share it with friends?
records.answerZh: 我會直接把連結傳給他們。如果他們也覺得好笑，我會很開心。
records.answerEn: I just send them the link. If they think it's funny too, I'm really happy.

records.questionZh: 你跟同事或朋友平常怎麼約時間見面？
records.questionEn: How do you usually set up a time to meet with coworkers or friends?
records.answerZh: 我們有一個聊天群組，大家都在裡面討論時間。不過常常聊了很久都決定不了。
records.answerEn: We have a group chat where everyone discusses times. But we often talk for ages and still can't decide.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有暈車或吃壞肚子的經驗？
records.questionEn: Have you ever gotten carsick or had an upset stomach from bad food?
records.answerZh: 有，我上次坐車去山上，山路太彎了，下車就嘔吐了。從那以後我坐車都先吃暈車藥。
records.answerEn: Yes, last time I rode up into the mountains, the road was so winding that I threw up as soon as I got out. Since then I always take motion sickness medicine before a ride.

records.questionZh: 你每天下班以後覺得怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: How do you feel after work every day?
records.answerZh: 我常常覺得很疲勞，回家只想躺在沙發上。週末我一定要睡飽才有精神。
records.answerEn: I often feel really worn out and just want to lie on the sofa when I get home. On weekends I have to get plenty of sleep to have any energy.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有受過很嚴重的傷？
records.questionEn: Have you ever had a serious injury?
records.answerZh: 有，我小時候從腳踏車上摔下來，手的骨頭斷了。打了兩個月的石膏。
records.answerEn: Yes, when I was little I fell off my bike and broke a bone in my arm. I had a cast on for two months.

records.questionZh: 你覺得自己每天睡得夠嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think you get enough sleep every day?
records.answerZh: 不太夠，我每天的睡眠大概只有六個小時。醫生說我應該要睡七、八個小時。
records.answerEn: Not really; I only get about six hours of sleep a day. The doctor says I should sleep seven or eight hours.

records.questionZh: 你比較喜歡台灣的天氣，還是你家鄉的天氣？
records.questionEn: Do you prefer Taiwan's weather or your hometown's weather?
records.answerZh: 我比較喜歡台灣的氣候，冬天不會太冷。不過夏天又熱又濕，有時候真的受不了。
records.answerEn: I prefer Taiwan's climate; winters aren't too cold. But summers are hot and humid, and sometimes I really can't stand it.

records.questionZh: 颱風或下大雨的時候，你住的地方會有什麼問題？
records.questionEn: During typhoons or heavy rain, what problems happen where you live?
records.answerZh: 我家附近的路常常淹水，機車都騎不過去。所以颱風天我都盡量不出門。
records.answerEn: The roads near my home often flood, so scooters can't get through. So on typhoon days I try not to go out.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣丟垃圾的方式跟你的國家一樣嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think the way people throw out trash in Taiwan is the same as in your country?
records.answerZh: 不一樣，台灣的垃圾分類很仔細。紙類、塑膠和廚餘都要分開，剛開始我常常搞錯。
records.answerEn: No, garbage sorting in Taiwan is very detailed. Paper, plastic, and food waste all have to be separated, and at first I often got it wrong.

records.questionZh: 你剛開始用中文跟人聊天時，有說錯話嗎？
records.questionEn: When you first started chatting with people in Chinese, did you say things wrong?
records.answerZh: 當然有，剛開始學難免會說錯。有一次我把「水餃」說成「睡覺」，大家都笑了。
records.answerEn: Of course. When you're just starting, mistakes are bound to happen. Once I said sleep instead of dumplings, and everyone laughed.

records.questionZh: 你家裡有兄弟姐妹嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
records.answerZh: 沒有，我是家裡唯一的孩子。所以小時候常常覺得有點寂寞。
records.answerEn: No, I'm the only child in my family. So I often felt a bit lonely as a kid.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台北交通最大的問題是什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you think is the biggest problem with Taipei's traffic?
records.answerZh: 我覺得機車太多了，常常造成塞車。上下班的時候，路上真的很亂。
records.answerEn: I think there are too many scooters, which often causes traffic jams. During rush hour, the roads are really chaotic.

records.questionZh: 你現在最想努力得到的是什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you most want to work hard to get right now?
records.answerZh: 我想爭取到公司派我去日本工作的機會。所以我最近每天晚上都在學日文。
records.answerEn: I want to win the chance for my company to send me to work in Japan. So lately I've been studying Japanese every night.

records.questionZh: 你覺得小孩每天可以玩多久手機？
records.questionEn: How long do you think kids should be allowed to use phones each day?
records.answerZh: 我覺得要限制在一個小時以內。玩太久對眼睛不好，也會影響睡眠。
records.answerEn: I think it should be limited to under an hour. Using them too long is bad for their eyes and affects their sleep.

records.questionZh: 你去診所看病的時候，第一步要做什麼？
records.questionEn: When you go to a clinic to see a doctor, what's the first step?
records.answerZh: 我會先到櫃台拿健保卡登記。然後坐著等護士叫我的名字。
records.answerEn: First I go to the counter and check in with my health insurance card. Then I sit and wait for the nurse to call my name.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣有參加過什麼特別的活動嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you taken part in any special activities in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我去年去鶯歌體驗做陶藝，自己做了一個杯子。雖然很醜，可是我很喜歡。
records.answerEn: Last year I went to Yingge to try making pottery and made a cup myself. It's ugly, but I love it.

records.questionZh: 你剛進公司的時候，有人教你怎麼做事嗎？
records.questionEn: When you first joined your company, did anyone teach you how to do things?
records.answerZh: 有，公司先給我們兩個禮拜的訓練。主管一步一步教我們怎麼用系統。
records.answerEn: Yes, the company first gave us two weeks of training. Our supervisor taught us how to use the system step by step.

records.questionZh: 你會用什麼方法記得每天花了多少錢？
records.questionEn: How do you keep track of how much you spend each day?
records.answerZh: 我每天都會用手機記錄自己花了多少錢。月底看一下，就知道錢花到哪裡去了。
records.answerEn: Every day I record how much I spend on my phone. When I look at it at the end of the month, I know where my money went.

records.questionZh: 你當初為什麼會對中文有興趣？
records.questionEn: Why did you become interested in Chinese in the first place?
records.answerZh: 我被中文字吸引，覺得每個字都像一幅畫。後來越學越有興趣。
records.answerEn: I was drawn to Chinese characters; each one seemed like a picture to me. Then the more I learned, the more interested I got.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣買東西，通常用現金還是刷卡？
records.questionEn: When you shop in Taiwan, do you usually use cash or a card?
records.answerZh: 我通常用手機付款，很快又方便。不過去夜市還是要帶現金。
records.answerEn: I usually pay with my phone; it's fast and convenient. But I still need to bring cash to the night market.

records.questionZh: 你覺得什麼樣的朋友最值得交？
records.questionEn: What kind of friends do you think are most worth having?
records.answerZh: 我覺得可靠的朋友最重要，有困難的時候會幫你。說好的事情也一定會做到。
records.answerEn: I think reliable friends matter most; they help you when you're in trouble. And they always do what they say they will.

records.questionZh: 參加朋友的婚禮，你會穿什麼？
records.questionEn: What would you wear to a friend's wedding?
records.answerZh: 我會穿得正式一點，穿襯衫和西裝外套。不過台灣的婚禮其實不用太正式。
records.answerEn: I'd dress a bit formally, in a shirt and a blazer. But Taiwanese weddings actually don't need to be too formal.

records.questionZh: 你理想中的家是什麼樣子？
records.questionEn: What does your ideal home look like?
records.answerZh: 我希望我的家又安靜又舒適，有一個大沙發。下班回家可以躺著看電影。
records.answerEn: I hope my home is quiet and cozy, with a big sofa. After work I could lie down and watch movies.

records.questionZh: 你感冒的時候，有什麼好方法讓自己快點好？
records.questionEn: When you have a cold, what's a good way to get better quickly?
records.answerZh: 我覺得多喝熱水、多睡覺最有效。如果還是不舒服，我就去看醫生。
records.answerEn: I think drinking lots of hot water and sleeping a lot works best. If I still feel bad, I go see a doctor.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有做過什麼很迷糊的事？
records.questionEn: Have you ever done something really scatterbrained?
records.answerZh: 有，我很糊塗，有一次穿兩隻不一樣的鞋子去上班。同事看到都笑翻了。
records.answerEn: Yes, I'm really scatterbrained. Once I went to work wearing two different shoes, and my coworkers cracked up when they saw.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣人說話的方式跟你的國家一樣嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think the way Taiwanese people talk is the same as in your country?
records.answerZh: 不太一樣，我的國家說話比較直接。台灣人常常說得很客氣，我有時候聽不出來真正的意思。
records.answerEn: Not quite. In my country people speak more directly. Taiwanese people often speak very politely, and sometimes I can't tell what they really mean.

records.questionZh: 你幾歲開始一個人在外面生活？
records.questionEn: At what age did you start living on your own?
records.answerZh: 我十八歲就搬出去住，從那時候開始學習獨立。現在煮飯、洗衣服都難不倒我。
records.answerEn: I moved out at eighteen and started learning to be independent then. Now cooking and doing laundry are no problem for me.

records.questionZh: 你覺得工作上，團隊比較重要還是自己的表現比較重要？
records.questionEn: At work, do you think the team matters more or your own performance?
records.answerZh: 我個人覺得團隊比較重要。一個人再厲害，也沒辦法把所有事情做完。
records.answerEn: Personally, I think the team matters more. No matter how capable one person is, they can't get everything done alone.

records.questionZh: 台灣的夏天熱到什麼程度？
records.questionEn: Just how hot does summer in Taiwan get?
records.answerZh: 台灣的夏天熱得不得了，走在路上一下子就流汗。我一天要洗兩次澡。
records.answerEn: Summer in Taiwan is extremely hot; you start sweating the moment you walk outside. I have to shower twice a day.

records.questionZh: 你覺得自己在台灣認識的人好不好？
records.questionEn: Do you think the people you've met in Taiwan are good people?
records.answerZh: 我覺得自己很幸運，在台灣認識了很多好朋友。他們常常帶我去吃好吃的東西。
records.answerEn: I think I'm very lucky to have made lots of good friends in Taiwan. They often take me out for good food.

records.questionZh: 你週末通常做什麼放鬆？
records.questionEn: What do you usually do to relax on weekends?
records.answerZh: 我週末最主要的娛樂就是去夜市逛逛。有時候也會在家看電影。
records.answerEn: My main entertainment on weekends is strolling around the night market. Sometimes I also watch movies at home.

records.questionZh: 你剛來台灣的時候，晚上睡得好嗎？
records.questionEn: When you first came to Taiwan, did you sleep well at night?
records.answerZh: 剛來的時候時差很嚴重，半夜三點都睡不著。大概過了一個禮拜才調回來。
records.answerEn: When I first arrived, my jet lag was terrible, and I couldn't sleep even at 3 a.m. It took about a week to adjust.

records.questionZh: 你參觀展覽的時候，最喜歡看哪一種藝術？
records.questionEn: When you visit exhibitions, what kind of art do you like most?
records.answerZh: 我很喜歡看攝影作品。上個月在美術館看到一個展覽，每張照片都很有感覺。
records.answerEn: I really like looking at photography works. Last month I saw an exhibition at an art museum, and every photo was really moving.

records.questionZh: 你平常在網路上都看什麼樣的影片？
records.questionEn: What kinds of videos do you usually watch online?
records.answerZh: 我訂閱了好幾個美食頻道。晚上吃飯的時候常常一邊吃一邊看。
records.answerEn: I've subscribed to several food channels. At dinner I often watch while I eat.

records.questionZh: 如果你要辦一個生日派對，你想辦成什麼樣子？
records.questionEn: If you were throwing a birthday party, what would you want it to be like?
records.answerZh: 我想辦一個復古的主題派對。大家都要穿八零年代的衣服來。
records.answerEn: I'd like to throw a retro theme party. Everyone would have to come dressed in clothes from the eighties.

records.questionZh: 交朋友的時候，你覺得長相重要嗎？
records.questionEn: When making friends, do you think looks matter?
records.answerZh: 我覺得外表沒那麼重要，個性比較重要。不過第一次見面還是會注意一下啦。
records.answerEn: I don't think appearance matters that much; personality is more important. But I still notice it a bit when meeting someone for the first time.

records.questionZh: 你小時候有什麼讓你難忘的事？
records.questionEn: What's something unforgettable from your childhood?
records.answerZh: 我最美好的回憶是跟爺爺去釣魚。現在想起來還是覺得很溫暖。
records.answerEn: My best memory is going fishing with my grandpa. Thinking about it now still feels very warm.

records.questionZh: 你跟同事聊天時，常聊什麼話題？
records.questionEn: What topics do you often talk about with your coworkers?
records.answerZh: 我們午休的時候很愛聊八卦。不過我只是聽，不太會亂講。
records.answerEn: We love to gossip during our lunch break. But I just listen; I don't really spread things around.

records.questionZh: 你曾經在很多人面前說話過嗎？感覺怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: Have you ever spoken in front of a lot of people? How did it feel?
records.answerZh: 我大學的時候上台演講過一次。緊張到手一直在抖，講完才鬆一口氣。
records.answerEn: I gave a speech on stage once in college. I was so nervous my hands kept shaking, and I only relaxed after I finished.

records.questionZh: 你學中文的時候，覺得四個字的固定說法難不難？
records.questionEn: When learning Chinese, do you find the fixed four-character expressions hard?
records.answerZh: 我覺得成語很難，因為每個背後都有故事。不過用對了，台灣朋友都會很驚訝。
records.answerEn: I think idioms are hard, because each one has a story behind it. But when I use one correctly, my Taiwanese friends are really surprised.

records.questionZh: 你覺得學中文寫字最難的是什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you think is the hardest part of writing Chinese?
records.answerZh: 對我來說繁體字筆畫太多了。不過寫久了會覺得很漂亮。
records.answerEn: For me, traditional characters have too many strokes. But after writing them for a while, I find them really beautiful.

records.questionZh: 你在家打掃地板通常用什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you usually use to clean the floor at home?
records.answerZh: 我都用吸塵器，比掃地快很多。家裡有養貓，所以幾乎每天都要吸一次。
records.answerEn: I always use a vacuum cleaner; it's much faster than sweeping. I have a cat, so I have to vacuum almost every day.

records.questionZh: 你遇到不開心的事情，會怎麼處理情緒？
records.questionEn: When something upsets you, how do you deal with your emotions?
records.answerZh: 我以前很容易發脾氣，常常對家人大聲說話。現在會先出去走一走再說。
records.answerEn: I used to lose my temper easily and often raised my voice at my family. Now I go out for a walk first.

records.questionZh: 你跟朋友意見不一樣的時候，會怎麼做？
records.questionEn: What do you do when you and a friend disagree?
records.answerZh: 我會先聽聽他的觀點，再說我自己的想法。不一定要吵架啊。
records.answerEn: I listen to his point of view first, then share my own thoughts. There's no need to argue.

records.questionZh: 你們家決定去哪裡旅行的時候，大家意見都一樣嗎？
records.questionEn: When your family decides where to travel, does everyone agree?
records.answerZh: 我們家意見很難一致，爸爸想去山上，媽媽想去海邊。最後通常都是猜拳決定。
records.answerEn: It's hard for my family to agree; Dad wants the mountains and Mom wants the beach. In the end we usually decide with rock-paper-scissors.

records.questionZh: 你怎麼知道一家餐廳好不好吃？
records.questionEn: How do you tell whether a restaurant is good?
records.answerZh: 我通常看排隊的人多不多來判斷。人越多，通常就越好吃。
records.answerEn: I usually judge by how many people are lined up. The more people, the better the food usually is.

records.questionZh: 你覺得自己以後會一直住在台灣嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think you'll stay in Taiwan for good?
records.answerZh: 我覺得一直住在台灣的可能性很高。我已經習慣這裡的生活了。
records.answerEn: I think the possibility that I'll stay in Taiwan for good is pretty high. I'm already used to life here.

records.questionZh: 你跟家人吵架以後，會試著站在對方那邊想嗎？
records.questionEn: After arguing with family, do you try to see things from their side?
records.answerZh: 我會試著從不同的角度去想。這樣比較能理解他為什麼生氣。
records.answerEn: I try to think about it from a different perspective. That way I can better understand why he's angry.

records.questionZh: 你小時候做錯事被抓到，會不會承認？
records.questionEn: As a kid, when you were caught doing something wrong, would you admit it?
records.answerZh: 我小時候打破花瓶，一直否認是我做的。結果媽媽看到地上的腳印，就知道了。
records.answerEn: When I was little I broke a vase and kept denying I did it. But my mom saw the footprints on the floor and knew.

records.questionZh: 如果用一句話說你今年的生活，你會怎麼說？
records.questionEn: If you described your life this year in one sentence, what would you say?
records.answerZh: 總結來說，今年雖然很忙，但是很充實。我學會了很多新東西。
records.answerEn: To sum up, this year was busy but fulfilling. I learned a lot of new things.

records.questionZh: 你覺得自己評價朋友的時候公平嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think you're fair when you judge your friends?
records.answerZh: 我盡量保持客觀，不會只看他好的地方。不過對好朋友，有時候還是會偏心。
records.answerEn: I try to stay objective and not only look at their good points. But with close friends, I'm sometimes still biased.

records.questionZh: 你的另一半跟異性朋友出去，你會不高興嗎？
records.questionEn: Would you be upset if your partner went out with a friend of the opposite sex?
records.answerZh: 老實說我會有一點吃醋。不過我知道要相信對方，所以不會說什麼。
records.answerEn: Honestly, I'd be a little jealous. But I know I should trust them, so I wouldn't say anything.

records.questionZh: 你最近做了什麼讓自己很驕傲的事？
records.questionEn: What have you done recently that made you proud?
records.answerZh: 我上禮拜第一次用中文跟房東講電話。講完以後我真的很得意。
records.answerEn: Last week I talked to my landlord on the phone in Chinese for the first time. Afterward I was really pleased with myself.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有被別人誤會的經驗？那時候感覺怎樣？
records.questionEn: Have you ever been misunderstood by someone? How did you feel?
records.answerZh: 有一次同事以為是我弄壞印表機，我覺得很委屈。後來查清楚了，他才跟我道歉。
records.answerEn: Once a coworker thought I broke the printer, and I felt really wronged. After it was cleared up, he apologized to me.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台北人對陌生人的態度怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: What do you think of how people in Taipei treat strangers?
records.answerZh: 我覺得大部分的人一點都不冷淡。我問路的時候，他們都很熱心幫忙。
records.answerEn: I think most people aren't cold at all. When I ask for directions, they're always eager to help.

records.questionZh: 你理想的伴侶是什麼樣的人？
records.questionEn: What is your ideal partner like?
records.answerZh: 我希望我的另一半有幽默感。兩個人在一起要常常笑才好。
records.answerEn: I hope my other half has a sense of humor. Two people together should laugh a lot.

records.questionZh: 住在國外的時候，你最想念家鄉的什麼？
records.questionEn: When living abroad, what do you miss most about home?
records.answerZh: 我最思念的是媽媽做的菜。在台灣怎麼找都找不到一樣的味道。
records.answerEn: What I long for most is my mom's cooking. No matter where I look in Taiwan, I can't find the same taste.

records.questionZh: 你找工作的時候，通常用什麼方法？
records.questionEn: When you look for work, what methods do you usually use?
records.answerZh: 我都上求職網站看工作機會。也會請朋友幫我介紹。
records.answerEn: I always check job openings on job-hunting websites. I also ask friends to refer me.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有想申請什麼，但是條件不夠的經驗？
records.questionEn: Have you ever wanted to apply for something but didn't meet the requirements?
records.answerZh: 我想申請一個獎學金，可是成績不夠，沒有資格。只好明年再試試看。
records.answerEn: I wanted to apply for a scholarship, but my grades weren't good enough, so I wasn't eligible. I'll just have to try again next year.

records.questionZh: 你跟你的主管相處得怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: How do you get along with your supervisor?
records.answerZh: 我的上司人很好，從來不會亂罵人。有問題我都可以直接找他談。
records.answerEn: My boss is really nice and never scolds people for no reason. If I have a problem, I can talk to him directly.

records.questionZh: 你做報告或工作的時候，都會提早完成嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you finish your reports or work early?
records.answerZh: 我常常拖到截止前一天才開始做。每次都熬夜，真的不是好習慣。
records.answerEn: I often put it off until the day before the deadline to start. I stay up late every time; it's really not a good habit.

records.questionZh: 你們公司怎麼決定年終獎金？
records.questionEn: How does your company decide year-end bonuses?
records.answerZh: 我們公司是看業績來決定的。今年業績不錯，所以大家都很期待。
records.answerEn: My company decides based on sales results. Results were good this year, so everyone is looking forward to it.

records.questionZh: 如果公司生意不好，你會怎麼辦？
records.questionEn: What would you do if your company's business was bad?
records.answerZh: 如果公司要減薪，我可能會開始找別的工作。房租那麼貴，薪水少了會很難過日子。
records.answerEn: If the company cut our pay, I might start looking for another job. Rent is so expensive that a smaller salary would make life hard.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣哪一種工作最有發展？
records.questionEn: Which kind of work do you think has the most potential in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我覺得科技產業最有發展。很多年輕人畢業後都想進去。
records.answerEn: I think the tech industry has the most potential. Lots of young people want to get into it after graduating.

records.questionZh: 如果你開一家小店，你最擔心什麼？
records.questionEn: If you opened a small shop, what would you worry about most?
records.answerZh: 我最擔心利潤太低。台北的店租很貴，賺的錢可能都拿去付房租了。
records.answerEn: I'd worry most about profits being too low. Shop rent in Taipei is expensive, so the money I make might all go to rent.

records.questionZh: 如果你是主管，你會怎麼在會議上開場？
records.questionEn: If you were a manager, how would you open a meeting?
records.answerZh: 我會先說「各位同仁辛苦了」。然後再簡單說明今天要討論的事。
records.answerEn: I'd start by saying, "Thank you for your hard work, colleagues." Then I'd briefly explain what we're discussing today.

records.questionZh: 你以後想做需要常常拜訪客人的工作嗎？
records.questionEn: Would you want a job that requires visiting clients often?
records.answerZh: 我不想當業務員，因為要一直跑客戶。我比較喜歡坐在辦公室裡做事。
records.answerEn: I don't want to be a salesperson, because you have to visit clients constantly. I prefer working in an office.

records.questionZh: 你上班的時候，最不喜歡做哪一種工作？
records.questionEn: What kind of task do you dislike most at work?
records.answerZh: 我最不喜歡做每個月的報表。數字一大堆，眼睛看得好累。
records.answerEn: I dislike doing the monthly reports the most. There are tons of numbers, and my eyes get so tired.

records.questionZh: 你今年有給自己定什麼目標嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you set any goals for yourself this year?
records.answerZh: 我希望今年中文能達到中級的程度。所以每天都會練習半個小時。
records.answerEn: I hope my Chinese reaches an intermediate level this year. So I practice for half an hour every day.

records.questionZh: 你覺得自己學中文的方法有什麼地方要改？
records.questionEn: Is there anything you think you should change about how you learn Chinese?
records.answerZh: 我覺得我的發音還需要改進。我打算每天跟著新聞唸十分鐘。
records.answerEn: I think my pronunciation still needs improving. I plan to read along with the news for ten minutes every day.

records.questionZh: 到目前為止，你最驕傲的事是什麼？
records.questionEn: What are you proudest of so far?
records.answerZh: 我最大的成就是一個人搬來台灣生活。一切都從零開始，真的不容易。
records.answerEn: My biggest achievement is moving to Taiwan on my own. I started everything from zero; it really wasn't easy.

records.questionZh: 你們辦公室的人意見不同時，誰來處理？
records.questionEn: When people in your office disagree, who handles it?
records.answerZh: 通常是我們組長來協調。他很會溝通，大家最後都能接受。
records.answerEn: Usually our team leader mediates. He's great at communicating, and everyone ends up accepting the outcome.

records.questionZh: 你工作上有遇過廠商東西送太晚的事嗎？
records.questionEn: At work, have you ever had a supplier deliver things too late?
records.answerZh: 上個月廠商延遲交貨，客人一直打電話來罵。我只好一直跟他們道歉。
records.answerEn: Last month a supplier delivered the goods late, and customers kept calling to complain. I had no choice but to keep apologizing.

records.questionZh: 開會之前，你都會先準備什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you prepare before a meeting?
records.answerZh: 我會先看一下會議的議程。這樣才知道要準備哪些資料。
records.answerEn: I look over the meeting agenda first. That way I know what materials to prepare.

records.questionZh: 如果你開一家咖啡店，你會怎麼讓更多人知道？
records.questionEn: If you opened a café, how would you let more people know about it?
records.answerZh: 我會在網路上做行銷，拍一些好看的照片。再請朋友幫忙分享。
records.answerEn: I'd do marketing online and take some nice photos. Then I'd ask friends to help share them.

records.questionZh: 你買的東西壞了，你會怎麼處理？
records.questionEn: What do you do when something you bought breaks?
records.answerZh: 我會先打電話給客服問問看。如果還在保固期，通常可以免費修。
records.answerEn: I first call customer service to ask. If it's still under warranty, it can usually be fixed for free.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣最重要的產業是什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you think is Taiwan's most important industry?
records.answerZh: 我覺得是半導體產業。我有好幾個朋友都在新竹工作。
records.answerEn: I think it's the semiconductor industry. Several of my friends work in Hsinchu.

records.questionZh: 你會擔心公司突然請很多人離開嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you worry your company might suddenly let a lot of people go?
records.answerZh: 我有點擔心，因為最近很多公司都在裁員。我只好多存一點錢，以防萬一。
records.answerEn: I'm a bit worried, because lots of companies have been laying people off lately. I'm saving a bit more money just in case.

records.questionZh: 你們公司誰負責找新人和處理薪水？
records.questionEn: Who at your company is in charge of hiring and handling salaries?
records.answerZh: 我們公司是人力資源部門負責的。有什麼問題都可以去找他們。
records.answerEn: At my company, the human resources department is in charge. You can go to them with any questions.

records.questionZh: 你覺得在台北一年要賺多少錢才夠用？
records.questionEn: How much do you think you need to earn per year to get by in Taipei?
records.answerZh: 我覺得年薪至少要七十萬才夠。房租和吃飯就花掉一大半了。
records.answerEn: I think you need an annual salary of at least 700,000 NT dollars. Rent and food take up more than half of it.

records.questionZh: 你的工作需要在假日或晚上上班嗎？
records.questionEn: Does your job require you to work on holidays or at night?
records.answerZh: 我們每個月要輪流在週末值班。值班的時候不能出去玩，有點無聊。
records.answerEn: Every month we take turns being on duty on weekends. When I'm on duty I can't go out, so it's a bit boring.

records.questionZh: 你剛開始工作的時候，誰幫你最多？
records.questionEn: When you first started working, who helped you the most?
records.answerZh: 我們公司有一位前輩很照顧我。我有不懂的地方都會問她。
records.answerEn: A senior colleague at my company really looked after me. Whenever I didn't understand something, I'd ask her.

records.questionZh: 你覺得在台灣找工作，認識很多人重要嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think knowing lots of people matters when job hunting in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我覺得人脈很重要。我現在的工作就是朋友介紹的。
records.answerEn: I think connections are really important. My current job came through a friend's referral.

records.questionZh: 你見過你們公司最大的老闆嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you met the top boss at your company?
records.answerZh: 我只在尾牙的時候看過總經理一次。他上台講話，大家都很安靜。
records.answerEn: I've only seen the general manager once, at the year-end party. When he spoke on stage, everyone was very quiet.

records.questionZh: 如果有人幫你處理工作上的小事，你希望他做什麼？
records.questionEn: If someone handled small tasks for you at work, what would you want them to do?
records.answerZh: 如果我有助理，我希望他幫我安排行程。這樣我就不會忘記開會了。
records.answerEn: If I had an assistant, I'd want them to arrange my schedule. That way I wouldn't forget meetings.

records.questionZh: 你住的大樓裡大概住了多少家人？
records.questionEn: About how many families live in your building?
records.answerZh: 我們大樓的住戶大概有五十戶。大家在電梯裡都會互相打招呼。
records.answerEn: Our building has about fifty households. Everyone says hello to each other in the elevator.

records.questionZh: 你家門外的空間乾淨嗎？
records.questionEn: Is the space outside your front door clean?
records.answerZh: 我們家門外的走廊有點窄。鄰居還會把鞋子放在那裡。
records.answerEn: The hallway outside my place is a bit narrow. The neighbors even leave their shoes there.

records.questionZh: 你住的地方有沒有遇過漏水的問題？
records.questionEn: Has your place ever had a leak?
records.answerZh: 上個月浴室的水管破了，地上都是水。我趕快打電話叫房東找人來修。
records.answerEn: Last month a water pipe in the bathroom burst and there was water all over the floor. I quickly called my landlord to get someone to fix it.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣騎車或開車，有沒有被罰過錢？
records.questionEn: Have you ever been fined while riding or driving in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 有一次我把機車停在紅線上，結果被拖吊了。花了一千多塊才領回來。
records.answerEn: Once I parked my scooter on a red line and it got towed. It cost me over a thousand NT dollars to get it back.

records.questionZh: 你覺得你家附近的公園怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: What do you think of the park near your home?
records.answerZh: 我家附近的公園設施很齊全，有溜滑梯也有運動器材。晚上很多人在那裡散步。
records.answerEn: The park near my home has complete facilities, with slides and exercise equipment. Lots of people walk there in the evening.

records.questionZh: 你覺得在捷運上大聲講電話可以嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think it's okay to talk loudly on the phone on the MRT?
records.answerZh: 我覺得在公共場所應該小聲一點。大聲講電話會吵到別人。
records.answerEn: I think you should keep your voice down in public places. Talking loudly on the phone bothers other people.

records.questionZh: 你覺得為什麼現在年輕人不太想生小孩？
records.questionEn: Why do you think young people today don't really want kids?
records.answerZh: 我覺得是房價太高、薪水太低，所以少子化越來越嚴重。很多朋友都說養不起小孩。
records.answerEn: I think it's because housing is too expensive and salaries are too low, so the declining birth rate keeps getting worse. Many friends say they can't afford to raise kids.

records.questionZh: 你知道你住的這一區，是誰代表你們去立法院嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you know who represents your district in the Legislative Yuan?
records.answerZh: 我不太清楚我們這區的立委是誰。不過選舉的時候，街上都有很多旗子。
records.answerEn: I'm not really sure who the legislator for our district is. But during elections there are lots of flags on the streets.

records.questionZh: 你覺得每個人都可以投票決定事情，重要嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think it's important that everyone can vote to decide things?
records.answerZh: 我覺得很重要，這就是民主的意思。每個人的聲音都應該被聽到。
records.answerEn: I think it's very important; that's what democracy means. Everyone's voice should be heard.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣的治安怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: What do you think of public safety in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我覺得台灣的犯罪率不高。半夜一個人走在路上也不太會害怕。
records.answerEn: I think the crime rate in Taiwan isn't high. Even walking alone at midnight, I'm not really scared.

records.questionZh: 你最近有看到什麼有趣的新聞嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you seen any interesting news lately?
records.answerZh: 我最近看到一篇報導，說台灣人一年喝掉很多杯珍珠奶茶。我覺得一點都不意外。
records.answerEn: I recently saw a news report saying Taiwanese people drink a huge number of bubble teas each year. I wasn't surprised at all.

records.questionZh: 你覺得一個好的社會成員應該做哪些事？
records.questionEn: What do you think a good member of society should do?
records.answerZh: 我覺得好公民應該遵守法律，也要關心社會。像垃圾分類這種小事也很重要。
records.answerEn: I think a good citizen should obey the law and care about society. Even small things like sorting trash matter.

records.questionZh: 每年五月你最忙的事是什麼？
records.questionEn: What keeps you busiest every May?
records.answerZh: 每年五月我都要上網繳稅。第一次弄的時候，還請同事幫我看。
records.answerEn: Every May I have to pay my taxes online. The first time, I even asked a coworker to check it for me.

records.questionZh: 你覺得最近大家的生意好做嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think business is easy for people lately?
records.answerZh: 我覺得最近景氣不太好。夜市很多攤子客人都變少了。
records.answerEn: I think the economy isn't doing great lately. Many night market stalls have fewer customers.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣的老人越來越多，會帶來什麼問題？
records.questionEn: With more and more elderly people in Taiwan, what problems might that bring?
records.answerZh: 我覺得高齡化會讓年輕人壓力變大。以後照顧老人的人可能會不夠。
records.answerEn: I think an aging society will put more pressure on young people. In the future there may not be enough people to care for the elderly.

records.questionZh: 你的公司除了薪水，還有給什麼補助嗎？
records.questionEn: Besides salary, does your company give you any other benefits?
records.answerZh: 我們公司每個月有交通津貼。我拿來付捷運的錢剛好夠用。
records.answerEn: My company gives a monthly transportation allowance. It's just enough to cover my MRT fares.

records.questionZh: 你覺得政府應該怎麼幫助沒有錢的家庭？
records.questionEn: How do you think the government should help families without money?
records.answerZh: 我覺得要讓貧窮家庭的小孩有機會好好讀書。教育可以改變他們的未來。
records.answerEn: I think kids from poor families should get the chance to study properly. Education can change their future.

records.questionZh: 颱風來的時候，你怎麼知道明天要不要上班？
records.questionEn: When a typhoon comes, how do you know whether you have to work tomorrow?
records.answerZh: 我都會看新聞，等市政府宣布放不放颱風假。宣布以前，大家都一直在滑手機。
records.answerEn: I watch the news and wait for the city government to announce whether there's a typhoon day off. Before the announcement, everyone keeps checking their phones.

records.questionZh: 你會記錄自己每個月花了多少錢嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you keep track of how much you spend each month?
records.answerZh: 我每個月都會統計一下自己的花費。發現大部分的錢都花在吃上面。
records.answerEn: Every month I add up my spending. I've found that most of my money goes to food.

records.questionZh: 你覺得你最近的睡眠狀況怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: How has your sleep been lately?
records.answerZh: 最近工作太忙，我的睡眠品質一直下降。白天上班常常打瞌睡。
records.answerEn: Work has been so busy that my sleep quality keeps declining. I often doze off at work during the day.

records.questionZh: 你有投資嗎？你會買股票嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you invest? Do you buy stocks?
records.answerZh: 我有買一點股票，但是不太敢放太多錢。股市上上下下，看了心臟會受不了。
records.answerEn: I've bought a few stocks, but I don't dare put in too much money. The stock market goes up and down so much my heart can't take it.

records.questionZh: 你覺得哪一種問題是每個國家都要面對的？
records.questionEn: What kind of problem do you think every country has to face?
records.answerZh: 我覺得全球暖化是大家都要面對的問題。夏天真的一年比一年熱。
records.answerEn: I think global warming is a problem everyone has to face. Summers really get hotter every year.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣有認識從別的國家搬來定居的人嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you know anyone in Taiwan who moved here from another country to settle?
records.answerZh: 我有一個鄰居是新住民，她是從越南來的。她煮的河粉超好吃。
records.answerEn: One of my neighbors is a new immigrant; she came from Vietnam. The pho she makes is super delicious.

records.questionZh: 你覺得在台灣找工作，讀到大學很重要嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think having a university degree matters for finding work in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我覺得學歷還是滿重要的，很多公司都要看。不過能力和經驗也很重要。
records.answerEn: I think educational background still matters quite a bit; many companies look at it. But ability and experience are also important.

records.questionZh: 你知道台灣從哪一年開始，兩個男生或兩個女生可以結婚嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you know in what year Taiwan began allowing two men or two women to marry?
records.answerZh: 台灣在二〇一九年讓同性婚姻合法。我有一對朋友去年也結婚了。
records.answerEn: Taiwan legalized same-sex marriage in 2019. A couple I'm friends with got married last year too.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有參加過幫助別人的活動？
records.questionEn: Have you ever taken part in an activity to help others?
records.answerZh: 我去年參加過一個慈善義賣。賣的錢全部捐給育幼院。
records.answerEn: Last year I took part in a charity sale. All the money raised was donated to an orphanage.

records.questionZh: 颱風或地震過後，你會想怎麼幫忙？
records.questionEn: After a typhoon or earthquake, how would you want to help?
records.answerZh: 我會捐錢或物資給救災團體。如果有時間，也想去當志工。
records.answerEn: I'd donate money or supplies to disaster relief groups. If I had time, I'd also want to volunteer.

records.questionZh: 你最近有注意到什麼新的法律嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you noticed any new laws recently?
records.answerZh: 我有看到新聞說，有一個跟外國人工作有關的法案正在討論。我覺得跟我很有關係。
records.answerEn: I saw on the news that a bill related to foreigners working here is being discussed. I think it really concerns me.

records.questionZh: 如果你可以改變你住的城市，你想做什麼？
records.questionEn: If you could change the city you live in, what would you do?
records.answerZh: 我想推動在城市裡蓋更多腳踏車道。這樣騎車上班會比較安全。
records.answerEn: I'd want to push for more bike lanes in the city. That way biking to work would be safer.

records.questionZh: 你覺得你住的地方交通方便嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think transportation is convenient where you live?
records.answerZh: 我覺得這幾年的交通建設進步很多。以前要坐公車，現在有捷運了。
records.answerEn: I think transportation infrastructure has improved a lot in recent years. I used to have to take the bus, but now there's the MRT.

records.questionZh: 你有想過去別的國家工作嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you ever thought about working in another country?
records.answerZh: 我有想過去海外工作幾年。可以多看看不同的世界。
records.answerEn: I've thought about working overseas for a few years. I could see more of the world.

records.questionZh: 新聞上常看到哪些政府官員出來說話？
records.questionEn: Which government officials do you often see speaking on the news?
records.answerZh: 颱風的時候常看到部長出來說明情況。不過我記不太住他們的名字。
records.answerEn: During typhoons I often see ministers come out to explain the situation. But I can't really remember their names.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有被選出來替大家去參加什麼活動？
records.questionEn: Have you ever been chosen to take part in an event on behalf of everyone?
records.answerZh: 我高中的時候是班上的代表，去參加演講比賽。雖然沒有得獎，但很好玩。
records.answerEn: In high school I was my class's representative in a speech contest. I didn't win, but it was fun.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有參加過比賽或選舉，結果沒選上？
records.questionEn: Have you ever entered a contest or election and not been chosen?
records.answerZh: 我國中的時候參加班長選舉，結果落選了。難過了好幾天。
records.answerEn: In junior high I ran for class president and lost the election. I was sad for days.

records.questionZh: 如果員工對公司不滿，他們可以怎麼做？
records.questionEn: If employees are unhappy with their company, what can they do?
records.answerZh: 他們可以先跟公司談，談不攏可能就會罷工。不過最好還是先好好溝通。
records.answerEn: They can talk with the company first, and if that fails, they might go on strike. But it's best to communicate properly first.

records.questionZh: 小時候你想做什麼工作？
records.questionEn: What job did you want when you were little?
records.answerZh: 我小時候想當法官，覺得很帥。後來發現要讀很多書，就放棄了。
records.answerEn: When I was little I wanted to be a judge; I thought it was cool. Later I found out you have to study a lot, so I gave up.

records.questionZh: 你看新聞的時候，常看到警察抓到什麼人？
records.questionEn: When you watch the news, who do you often see the police catching?
records.answerZh: 新聞常說警察抓到嫌犯了。不過在判決之前，還不能說他一定有罪。
records.answerEn: The news often says the police caught a suspect. But before the verdict, you can't say he's definitely guilty.

records.questionZh: 你跟朋友喝完酒以後，怎麼回家？
records.questionEn: How do you get home after drinking with friends?
records.answerZh: 我們一定叫計程車回家，絕對不酒駕。被抓到罰很重，也很危險。
records.answerEn: We always take a taxi home and never drive drunk. The fines are heavy if you're caught, and it's dangerous.

records.questionZh: 前幾年大家都戴口罩的時候，你的生活有什麼改變？
records.questionEn: A few years ago when everyone wore masks, how did your life change?
records.answerZh: 疫情的時候我都在家上班。一開始很開心，後來覺得好悶。
records.answerEn: During the pandemic I worked from home. At first I was happy, but later I felt really cooped up.

records.questionZh: 你在外面吃東西，會擔心衛生問題嗎？
records.questionEn: When you eat out, do you worry about hygiene?
records.answerZh: 我有一點擔心食安問題。所以我比較常去自己熟的店吃。
records.answerEn: I'm a bit worried about food safety. So I tend to eat at places I know well.

records.questionZh: 你常常留在公司做到很晚嗎？有多拿錢嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you often stay late at work? Do you get paid extra?
records.answerZh: 我常常加班，可是公司不給加班費。我覺得很不公平。
records.answerEn: I often work overtime, but the company doesn't give overtime pay. I think it's really unfair.

records.questionZh: 在台灣，女生生小孩以後可以休息多久？
records.questionEn: In Taiwan, how long can women take off after having a baby?
records.answerZh: 在台灣產假大概是八個禮拜。我姊姊覺得太短了，小孩還那麼小。
records.answerEn: In Taiwan, maternity leave is about eight weeks. My older sister thinks it's too short since the baby is still so small.

records.questionZh: 你以後老了，想住在哪裡？
records.questionEn: When you get old, where do you want to live?
records.answerZh: 我不排斥住養老院，那裡有人照顧。而且可以交很多朋友。
records.answerEn: I'm not against living in a retirement home; there are people to look after you. And you can make lots of friends.

records.questionZh: 你覺得社會應該怎麼照顧需要幫助的人？
records.questionEn: How do you think society should take care of people who need help?
records.answerZh: 我覺得政府應該多照顧弱勢的人。像身心障礙者和獨居老人。
records.answerEn: I think the government should take better care of the disadvantaged, like people with disabilities and seniors living alone.

records.questionZh: 如果你常聽到鄰居家有人在哭叫，你會怎麼做？
records.questionEn: If you often heard someone crying and screaming at your neighbor's, what would you do?
records.answerZh: 如果懷疑是家暴，我會打一一三專線。我覺得不能假裝沒聽到。
records.answerEn: If I suspected domestic violence, I'd call the 113 hotline. I don't think you can pretend you didn't hear it.

records.questionZh: 在台灣生活，看病為什麼那麼便宜？
records.questionEn: Why is seeing a doctor so cheap when living in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 因為台灣的國民都有全民健保。我是外國人，在這裡工作也有健保卡。
records.answerEn: Because Taiwanese nationals all have national health insurance. I'm a foreigner, but working here I have a health insurance card too.

records.questionZh: 農曆七月的時候，你有看過大家在門口拜拜嗎？
records.questionEn: During the seventh lunar month, have you seen people making offerings outside their doors?
records.answerZh: 有啊，農曆七月很多店家都會辦普渡。門口會擺很多零食和飲料。
records.answerEn: Yes, in the seventh lunar month many shops make offerings to the wandering spirits. They set out lots of snacks and drinks outside.

records.questionZh: 你去過台灣的廟嗎？在裡面做了什麼？
records.questionEn: Have you been to a temple in Taiwan? What did you do there?
records.answerZh: 我去過一次，還跟朋友一起求籤。籤上寫的話很難懂，還要請廟裡的人解釋。
records.answerEn: I went once and drew fortune sticks with a friend. The words on the slip were hard to understand, so we had to ask someone at the temple to explain.

records.questionZh: 你最喜歡台灣的哪一個節日？為什麼？
records.questionEn: Which Taiwanese holiday do you like best? Why?
records.answerZh: 我最喜歡元宵節，因為可以去看燈會。台灣的節慶都很熱鬧。
records.answerEn: I like the Lantern Festival best, because I can go see the lantern fair. Festivals in Taiwan are always lively.

records.questionZh: 你參加過台灣人的婚禮嗎？感覺怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: Have you been to a Taiwanese wedding? What was it like?
records.answerZh: 我參加過一次喜宴，菜一道一道上，吃都吃不完。新郎新娘還會一桌一桌來敬酒。
records.answerEn: I went to a wedding banquet once; the dishes kept coming and I couldn't finish them. The bride and groom also came round table by table to toast.

records.questionZh: 你有參加過台灣的喪禮嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you ever attended a funeral in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我參加過同事爸爸的告別式。大家都穿黑色或白色的衣服，很安靜。
records.answerEn: I attended the memorial service for a coworker's father. Everyone wore black or white, and it was very quiet.

records.questionZh: 你看過台灣傳統的偶戲表演嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you seen a traditional Taiwanese puppet show?
records.answerZh: 我在廟口看過布袋戲。表演的人用手讓小人偶打架，好厲害。
records.answerEn: I saw a glove puppet show in front of a temple. The performers made the little puppets fight with their hands; it was amazing.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣旅行時，喜歡買什麼紀念品？
records.questionEn: When traveling in Taiwan, what souvenirs do you like to buy?
records.answerZh: 我喜歡去文創園區買手作的小東西。很有台灣的特色。
records.answerEn: I like going to cultural and creative parks to buy little handmade things. They have a very Taiwanese character.

records.questionZh: 你平常用什麼方式跟朋友分享生活？
records.questionEn: How do you usually share your life with friends?
records.answerZh: 我常在社群網站上發照片。朋友按讚的時候我會很開心。
records.answerEn: I often post photos on social media. I'm happy when my friends like them.

records.questionZh: 你家裡有哪些東西是要充電的？
records.questionEn: What things in your home need charging?
records.answerZh: 我家裡的電子產品很多，像手機、電腦和平板。每天晚上都要排隊充電。
records.answerEn: I have lots of electronic devices at home, like my phone, computer, and tablet. Every night they have to take turns charging.

records.questionZh: 你希望以後有什麼東西幫你做家事？
records.questionEn: What would you like to have help you with housework in the future?
records.answerZh: 我希望有一個機器人幫我洗碗和摺衣服。這樣我就有更多時間休息了。
records.answerEn: I'd like a robot to wash dishes and fold clothes for me. That way I'd have more time to rest.

records.questionZh: 你寫報告的時候，會從網路上找資料嗎？
records.questionEn: When you write a report, do you look for information online?
records.answerZh: 我會先把重要的資料複製貼上，存在筆記裡。最後再用自己的話重寫。
records.answerEn: I copy and paste the important information into my notes first. Then I rewrite it in my own words at the end.

records.questionZh: 你在網路上填表格的時候，會擔心什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you worry about when filling out forms online?
records.answerZh: 我很怕個資外洩，所以不會亂填電話和地址。不明的網站我都不敢用。
records.answerEn: I'm really afraid of my personal data leaking, so I don't carelessly fill in my phone number and address. I don't dare use unknown websites.

records.questionZh: 你的手機系統常常更新嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you update your phone's system often?
records.answerZh: 我的手機一直跳出新版本的通知。可是我怕更新後變慢，所以一直沒更新。
records.answerEn: My phone keeps showing notifications about a new version. But I'm afraid it'll get slower after updating, so I haven't updated.

records.questionZh: 你剛來台灣的時候，身體有不舒服嗎？
records.questionEn: When you first came to Taiwan, did you have any health issues?
records.answerZh: 剛來的時候因為飲食改變，我有一點便祕。後來多吃青菜水果就好了。
records.answerEn: When I first arrived, my diet changed and I was a bit constipated. Later, eating more vegetables and fruit fixed it.

records.questionZh: 你去健身房都練什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you train when you go to the gym?
records.answerZh: 我主要練腿部的肌肉。練完隔天走路都很痠。
records.answerEn: I mainly train my leg muscles. The next day, my legs are sore when I walk.

records.questionZh: 你朋友做過最瘋狂的事情是什麼？
records.questionEn: What's the craziest thing a friend of yours has done?
records.answerZh: 我朋友半夜兩點說要開車去海邊看日出，真的很神經。不過我後來也跟去了。
records.answerEn: My friend said at 2 a.m. that he wanted to drive to the beach to watch the sunrise; he's really crazy. But I ended up going too.

records.questionZh: 你覺得臉上哪個地方最能看出一個人的心情？
records.questionEn: Which part of the face do you think shows a person's mood the most?
records.answerZh: 我覺得是眉毛。我生氣的時候眉毛會皺在一起，朋友馬上就知道。
records.answerEn: I think it's the eyebrows. When I'm angry my eyebrows knit together, and my friends know right away.

records.questionZh: 你去醫院看病的時候，通常要等很久嗎？
records.questionEn: When you go to the hospital, do you usually have to wait a long time?
records.answerZh: 大醫院的病人很多，我常常要等一個多小時。所以小感冒我都去附近的診所。
records.answerEn: Big hospitals have lots of patients, and I often wait over an hour. So for a small cold I go to a nearby clinic.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣人喝含糖飲料太多嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think Taiwanese people drink too many sugary drinks?
records.answerZh: 我覺得太多了，很多人每天都喝手搖飲。喝太多甜的，以後容易得糖尿病。
records.answerEn: I think it's too many; lots of people drink handmade tea drinks every day. Drinking too much sugar makes it easy to get diabetes later.

records.questionZh: 你回家以後第一件事是做什麼？
records.questionEn: What's the first thing you do when you get home?
records.answerZh: 我回家第一件事就是洗手。外面摸過的東西都有很多細菌。
records.answerEn: The first thing I do when I get home is wash my hands. Things you touch outside have lots of germs.

records.questionZh: 你有住過院嗎？是為了什麼？
records.questionEn: Have you ever been hospitalized? What for?
records.answerZh: 我前年因為盲腸炎住院，動了一個小手術。住了三天就出院了。
records.answerEn: The year before last I was hospitalized for appendicitis and had a minor surgery. I was discharged after three days.

records.questionZh: 你受傷以後，都怎麼讓身體恢復？
records.questionEn: After you get injured, how do you help your body recover?
records.answerZh: 我去年膝蓋受傷，每個禮拜都要去做復健。做了三個月才慢慢好起來。
records.answerEn: Last year I hurt my knee and had to go to physical therapy every week. It took three months before it slowly got better.

records.questionZh: 下雨下很久的時候，你的心情會受影響嗎？
records.questionEn: When it rains for a long time, does it affect your mood?
records.answerZh: 會啊，連續下雨好幾天，我就覺得有點憂鬱。這時候我會去咖啡廳坐坐。
records.answerEn: Yes, when it rains for several days in a row, I feel a bit gloomy. Then I go sit in a café for a while.

records.questionZh: 你或你身邊的人有沒有想改掉什麼壞習慣？
records.questionEn: Have you or someone close to you wanted to break a bad habit?
records.answerZh: 我爸爸試著戒菸好幾次了。這次他說是真的，大家都在幫他加油。
records.answerEn: My dad has tried to quit smoking several times. This time he says he means it, and everyone is cheering him on.

records.questionZh: 冬天的時候，你覺得台灣的空氣怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: What do you think of Taiwan's air in winter?
records.answerZh: 冬天空汙比較嚴重，天空常常灰灰的。出門我都會戴口罩。
records.answerEn: Air pollution is worse in winter, and the sky is often gray. I always wear a mask when I go out.

records.questionZh: 你覺得最近的天氣跟以前比有什麼不一樣？
records.questionEn: How do you think the weather lately is different from before?
records.answerZh: 我覺得因為氣候變遷，夏天越來越熱。颱風好像也變得更強了。
records.answerEn: I think because of climate change, summers are getting hotter and hotter. Typhoons seem to be getting stronger too.

records.questionZh: 夏天下午的大雷雨，你會怕嗎？
records.questionEn: Are you scared of the big summer afternoon thunderstorms?
records.answerZh: 我有點怕閃電，尤其是在外面騎車的時候。所以下大雨我都會先找地方躲。
records.answerEn: I'm a bit scared of lightning, especially when I'm riding outside. So when it pours I find somewhere to take shelter.

records.questionZh: 你住的地方有沒有限水過？
records.questionEn: Has there ever been water rationing where you live?
records.answerZh: 有一年春天缺水，我們家每週停水兩天。我只好先用水桶裝水。
records.answerEn: One spring there was a water shortage, and our water was cut off two days a week. I had to store water in buckets beforehand.

records.questionZh: 你覺得人應該怎麼保護野生動物？
records.questionEn: How do you think people should protect wild animals?
records.answerZh: 我覺得要做好保育，不要買野生動物做的東西。也不要隨便去打擾牠們。
records.answerEn: I think we need to do conservation well and not buy things made from wild animals. We also shouldn't disturb them.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣應該用什麼方式發電？
records.questionEn: How do you think Taiwan should generate electricity?
records.answerZh: 這個問題很難，核能和綠能各有好處和缺點。我覺得大家應該多了解再決定。
records.answerEn: It's a tough question; nuclear power and green energy each have pros and cons. I think people should learn more before deciding.

records.questionZh: 你去買飲料的時候，會自己帶杯子嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you bring your own cup when you buy drinks?
records.answerZh: 我會自己帶環保杯，少用塑膠杯。店家還會便宜五塊錢。
records.answerEn: I bring my own reusable cup and use fewer plastic cups. The shop even gives me five NT dollars off.

records.questionZh: 你覺得城市裡空氣不好，最主要是什麼原因？
records.questionEn: What do you think is the main reason for bad air in the city?
records.answerZh: 我覺得是機車和工廠排放的廢氣太多。如果大家多搭捷運，應該會好一點。
records.answerEn: I think scooters and factories emit too much exhaust. If people took the MRT more, it should be a bit better.

records.questionZh: 你去爬山或去海邊玩的時候，會注意什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you pay attention to when hiking or going to the beach?
records.answerZh: 我會把垃圾帶走，不要破壞環境。也不會隨便摘花或撿珊瑚。
records.answerEn: I take my trash with me so I don't damage the environment. I also don't pick flowers or take coral.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有跟在網路上認識的人見過面？
records.questionEn: Have you ever met in person someone you got to know online?
records.answerZh: 我跟一個網友見過面，我們都喜歡打電動。現在變成很好的朋友了。
records.answerEn: I've met an online friend in person; we both love video games. Now we've become good friends.

records.questionZh: 你拍照上傳以前，都會修圖嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you edit your photos before posting them?
records.answerZh: 我都會加一點濾鏡，讓顏色好看一點。不過不會修到不像自己。
records.answerEn: I always add a bit of a filter to make the colors look nicer. But I don't edit until I don't look like myself.

records.questionZh: 你覺得手機上推給你的影片準不準？
records.questionEn: Do you think the videos recommended to you on your phone are accurate?
records.answerZh: 很準，演算法好像比我還了解我。我看了一次貓的影片，現在一直推貓給我。
records.answerEn: Very accurate; the algorithm seems to know me better than I do. I watched one cat video, and now it keeps recommending cats.

records.questionZh: 如果別的公司給你更高的薪水，你會換工作嗎？
records.questionEn: If another company offered you a higher salary, would you change jobs?
records.answerZh: 如果薪水高很多，我可能會跳槽。不過我也會看工作環境和同事。
records.answerEn: If the salary were much higher, I might switch companies. But I'd also consider the work environment and coworkers.

records.questionZh: 你們公司怎麼看員工表現好不好？
records.questionEn: How does your company assess whether employees are performing well?
records.answerZh: 我們公司每半年有一次考核。主管會跟我們一個一個談。
records.answerEn: My company has a performance review every six months. The supervisor talks with us one by one.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣找房子的時候，是怎麼找到的？
records.questionEn: How did you find a place to live in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我是透過仲介找到的，比較省時間。不過要多付半個月的房租當服務費。
records.answerEn: I found it through an agent, which saved time. But I had to pay an extra half month's rent as a service fee.

records.questionZh: 你喜歡什麼樣的房子？
records.questionEn: What kind of home do you like?
records.answerZh: 我喜歡格局方正的房子，不要有太多走道。客廳最好大一點，可以請朋友來玩。
records.answerEn: I like homes with a square layout, without too many hallways. The living room should ideally be big so I can invite friends over.

records.questionZh: 你平常會吃什麼東西讓身體更健康嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you take anything regularly to stay healthier?
records.answerZh: 我會吃一些保健食品，像魚油和維他命。不過我覺得睡飽還是最重要。
records.answerEn: I take some health supplements, like fish oil and vitamins. But I think getting enough sleep is still the most important.

records.questionZh: 你有試過中醫的治療方式嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you tried traditional Chinese medicine treatments?
records.answerZh: 我有一次肩膀很痛，去中醫診所做針灸。一開始很怕，但是其實不太痛。
records.answerEn: Once my shoulder hurt a lot, so I went to a Chinese medicine clinic for acupuncture. I was scared at first, but it actually didn't hurt much.

records.questionZh: 台灣的夏天那麼熱，你出門會注意什麼？
records.questionEn: Taiwan's summers are so hot; what do you watch out for when you go out?
records.answerZh: 我出門一定會帶水，怕中暑。中午太陽太大，我盡量不出門。
records.answerEn: I always bring water when I go out because I'm afraid of getting heatstroke. At noon the sun is too strong, so I try not to go out.

records.questionZh: 搬到一個新的地方，你一開始會覺得怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: When you move somewhere new, how do you feel at first?
records.answerZh: 我一開始會有點不安，因為什麼都不熟。不過認識鄰居以後就好多了。
records.answerEn: At first I feel a bit uneasy, because nothing is familiar. But once I get to know the neighbors it's much better.

records.questionZh: 颱風天的時候，住在山區的人要小心什麼？
records.questionEn: During a typhoon, what should people living in the mountains be careful of?
records.answerZh: 住在山區的人要小心土石流。雨太大的時候最好早點離開。
records.answerEn: People living in the mountains should watch out for mudslides. When the rain is too heavy, it's best to leave early.

records.questionZh: 你覺得學中文只要背單字就好了嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think learning Chinese is just about memorizing vocabulary?
records.answerZh: 學中文並非只要背單字就好。還要多聽多說，才能真的用出來。
records.answerEn: Learning Chinese is by no means just memorizing words. You have to listen and speak a lot to really use it.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣最喜歡吃哪些小吃？
records.questionEn: Which snacks do you like most in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我喜歡很多小吃，像是滷肉飯和臭豆腐。每次去夜市都吃到很飽。
records.answerEn: I like lots of snacks, such as braised pork rice and stinky tofu. Every time I go to the night market I eat until I'm stuffed.

records.questionZh: 如果可以回到很久很久以前，你想去看看嗎？
records.questionEn: If you could go back to the distant past, would you want to take a look?
records.answerZh: 我想去古代看看，但是只待一天就好。沒有冷氣和手機，我應該受不了。
records.answerEn: I'd like to visit ancient times, but only for a day. Without air conditioning and a phone, I don't think I could stand it.

records.questionZh: 你身邊的朋友大部分都是台灣人嗎？
records.questionEn: Are most of your friends Taiwanese?
records.answerZh: 我的朋友多數是台灣人，只有少數是外國人。所以我中文進步得很快。
records.answerEn: Most of my friends are Taiwanese; only a few are foreigners. So my Chinese has improved quickly.

records.questionZh: 你覺得一個好老師應該要有什麼特質？
records.questionEn: What qualities do you think a good teacher should have?
records.answerZh: 我覺得好老師要具有耐心。學生問很多次，也不會生氣。
records.answerEn: I think a good teacher should have patience. Even if students ask many times, they don't get angry.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣生活遇過最大的困難是什麼？
records.questionEn: What's the biggest difficulty you've had living in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我剛來的時候，面臨最大的問題是語言。去銀行辦事都聽不懂。
records.answerEn: When I first came, the biggest problem I faced was the language. I couldn't understand anything when doing things at the bank.

records.questionZh: 你來台灣以後，有什麼新的生活習慣？
records.questionEn: What new daily habits have you picked up since coming to Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我來台灣以後形成了一個習慣，每天早上都去早餐店。我最喜歡吃蛋餅。
records.answerEn: Since coming to Taiwan I've formed a habit of going to a breakfast shop every morning. My favorite is the egg crepe.

records.questionZh: 你壓力很大的時候，會做什麼讓自己舒服一點？
records.questionEn: When you're very stressed, what do you do to feel better?
records.answerZh: 我會去跑步來減輕壓力。流完汗心情就會好很多。
records.answerEn: I go running to ease the stress. After sweating, I feel much better.

records.questionZh: 你找房子的時候，最在意什麼條件？
records.questionEn: When looking for a place to live, what conditions do you care about most?
records.answerZh: 房子一定要符合我的預算，還要離捷運站近。可是這樣的房子很難找。
records.answerEn: The place has to fit my budget and be close to an MRT station. But places like that are hard to find.

records.questionZh: 你知道台灣過年為什麼喜歡用紅色嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you know why people in Taiwan like to use red at Lunar New Year?
records.answerZh: 我聽說紅色象徵好運和喜氣。所以過年的時候到處都是紅色的春聯。
records.answerEn: I heard red symbolizes good luck and joy. So at New Year there are red couplets everywhere.

records.questionZh: 你覺得主管應該怎麼對待新進員工？
records.questionEn: How do you think managers should treat new employees?
records.answerZh: 我覺得主管應該給予新人多一點時間學習。不要一開始就給太大的壓力。
records.answerEn: I think managers should give new hires more time to learn. They shouldn't put too much pressure on them right away.

records.questionZh: 你覺得你的父母為你做了什麼？
records.questionEn: What do you think your parents have done for you?
records.answerZh: 我爸媽為我付出了很多時間和金錢。我很希望以後能好好報答他們。
records.answerEn: My parents put a lot of time and money into me. I really hope I can repay them well in the future.

records.questionZh: 誰是對你的人生改變最大的人？
records.questionEn: Who is the person who has changed your life the most?
records.answerZh: 我的高中老師對我很有影響力。是她讓我開始對語言有興趣的。
records.answerEn: My high school teacher has had a lot of influence on me. She's the one who got me interested in languages.

records.questionZh: 你覺得結婚以後，兩個人的錢應該要分開嗎？
records.questionEn: After marriage, do you think a couple should keep their money separate?
records.answerZh: 我覺得財產可以分開，但是生活費一起出。這樣比較不會吵架。
