records.answerEn: I think assets can be kept separate, but living expenses should be shared. That way there are fewer arguments.

records.questionZh: 如果你想自己開店，你最需要準備什麼？
records.questionEn: If you wanted to open your own shop, what would you most need to prepare?
records.answerZh: 我最需要的是資金，開店要花很多錢。我打算先存三年再說。
records.answerEn: What I need most is capital; opening a shop costs a lot of money. I plan to save for three years first.

records.questionZh: 你在便利商店除了買東西，還會做什麼？
records.questionEn: Besides shopping, what else do you do at convenience stores?
records.answerZh: 我常用店裡的機器印文件和繳費。很方便，不用跑去郵局。
records.answerEn: I often use the machine in the store to print documents and pay bills. It's convenient; I don't have to go to the post office.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣租房子，房租裡面還有什麼費用？
records.questionEn: When you rent in Taiwan, what other fees are in your rent?
records.answerZh: 我的房租有包含管理費和網路費。可是電費要另外算。
records.answerEn: My rent includes the building management fee and the internet fee. But electricity is charged separately.

records.questionZh: 你要傳很大的照片給朋友的時候，會怎麼做？
records.questionEn: What do you do when you need to send a big photo to a friend?
records.answerZh: 我會先把照片縮小一點再傳。不然手機網路很慢，要等很久。
records.answerEn: I shrink the photo a little before sending it. Otherwise my phone's internet is slow and it takes forever.

records.questionZh: 你今年有什麼一定要做到的事嗎？
records.questionEn: Is there something you're set on accomplishing this year?
records.answerZh: 我下定決心今年要考過中文檢定。每天都會念書一個小時。
records.answerEn: I've made up my mind to pass the Chinese proficiency test this year. I study for an hour every day.

records.questionZh: 你朋友要做一件很危險的事，你會怎麼做？
records.questionEn: If a friend was about to do something very dangerous, what would you do?
records.answerZh: 我一定會阻止他，就算他會生氣。朋友的安全比較重要。
records.answerEn: I'd definitely stop him, even if he got angry. My friend's safety is more important.

records.questionZh: 你住飯店的時候，會在意早餐幾點結束嗎？
records.questionEn: When you stay at a hotel, do you care what time breakfast ends?
records.answerZh: 我喜歡早餐供應到十點的飯店。這樣假日可以睡晚一點。
records.answerEn: I like hotels that serve breakfast until ten. That way I can sleep in a bit on holidays.

records.questionZh: 你一個人住以後，對家人有什麼新的想法？
records.questionEn: Since living on your own, what new thoughts do you have about your family?
records.answerZh: 我一個人住以後，才體會到媽媽做家事有多辛苦。現在每次回家都會幫忙洗碗。
records.answerEn: Only after living alone did I come to understand how hard my mom works on housework. Now every time I go home, I help wash the dishes.

records.questionZh: 你平常會特別注意哪一類的新聞？
records.questionEn: What kind of news do you pay special attention to?
records.answerZh: 我最近很關注房價的新聞。因為我在考慮要不要買房子。
records.answerEn: Lately I've been following news about housing prices closely. That's because I'm considering whether to buy a home.

records.questionZh: 你學新東西的時候，喜歡自己學還是有人教？
records.questionEn: When you learn something new, do you prefer learning alone or being taught?
records.answerZh: 我喜歡有老師指導，學得比較快。自己學常常不知道哪裡做錯。
records.answerEn: I like having a teacher to guide me; I learn faster. When I learn alone, I often don't know what I'm doing wrong.

records.questionZh: 你買新手機以後，第一件事會做什麼？
records.questionEn: What's the first thing you do after buying a new phone?
records.answerZh: 我會先測試一下相機拍起來怎麼樣。我很常拍食物照片，所以很重要。
records.answerEn: I first test how the camera takes pictures. I take a lot of food photos, so it's important.

records.questionZh: 如果你們社區要辦活動，你會怎麼讓大家知道？
records.questionEn: If your neighborhood was holding an event, how would you let everyone know?
records.answerZh: 我會在社區群組宣傳，再貼海報在電梯裡。這樣大家應該都看得到。
records.answerEn: I'd promote it in the neighborhood group chat and put a poster in the elevator. That way everyone should see it.

records.questionZh: 你學過的外語，很久沒用會怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: What happens to a foreign language you've learned when you don't use it for a long time?
records.answerZh: 我高中學過日文，很久沒用就退步很多了。現在只記得怎麼打招呼。
records.answerEn: I learned Japanese in high school, but it's gotten much worse since I haven't used it in a long time. Now I only remember how to say hello.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有遇過被騙錢的經驗？
records.questionEn: Have you ever been scammed out of money?
records.answerZh: 我有一次在網路上買東西被騙，損失了三千塊。從那次以後我都選貨到付款。
records.answerEn: Once I got scammed buying something online and lost three thousand NT dollars. Since then I always choose cash on delivery.

records.questionZh: 你在網路上看到奇怪的消息，會馬上相信嗎？
records.questionEn: When you see strange news online, do you believe it right away?
records.answerZh: 我不會馬上相信，因為很多都是謠言。我會先查查看有沒有正式的新聞。
records.answerEn: I don't believe it right away, because a lot of it is rumors. I first check whether there's official news about it.

records.questionZh: 你覺得你和你父母那一代的想法有什麼不同？
records.questionEn: How do you think your thinking differs from your parents' generation?
records.answerZh: 我爸媽的觀念比較傳統，覺得一定要買房子。我覺得租房子也沒什麼不好。
records.answerEn: My parents' way of thinking is more traditional; they think you must buy a home. I think renting isn't bad at all.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣人搭捷運的時候怎麼樣？
records.questionEn: What do you think of how Taiwanese people behave on the MRT?
records.answerZh: 我覺得大家很守秩序，都會排隊上車。搭電扶梯也會靠右站。
records.answerEn: I think everyone is very orderly and lines up to board. On escalators they also stand on the right.

records.questionZh: 你覺得什麼樣的人看起來很有魅力？
records.questionEn: What kind of person do you think seems really attractive?
records.answerZh: 我覺得有氣質的人很有魅力。說話溫柔、穿著乾淨，就很吸引人。
records.answerEn: I think people with poise are very attractive. Speaking gently and dressing neatly is really appealing.

records.questionZh: 你住的城市裡，哪裡最熱鬧？
records.questionEn: Where is the liveliest part of the city you live in?
records.answerZh: 我覺得車站附近的區域最熱鬧。百貨公司、餐廳和補習班都在那裡。
records.answerEn: I think the area around the train station is the liveliest. Department stores, restaurants, and cram schools are all there.

records.questionZh: 你拍照的時候，最喜歡在哪裡拍？
records.questionEn: Where do you most like to take photos?
records.answerZh: 我喜歡用山或海當背景。這樣照片看起來會比較漂亮。
records.answerEn: I like using mountains or the sea as the background. That way the photos look nicer.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣可以騎機車嗎？要先辦什麼？
records.questionEn: Can you ride a scooter in Taiwan? What do you need to get first?
records.answerZh: 我去年考到機車的駕駛執照了。現在去哪裡都很方便。
records.answerEn: Last year I passed the test and got my scooter driver's license. Now it's convenient to go anywhere.

records.questionZh: 你覺得住在台北，什麼最花錢？
records.questionEn: What do you think costs the most when living in Taipei?
records.answerZh: 我覺得台北的消費很高，尤其是房租。吃飯倒是還好，有很多便宜的小吃。
records.answerEn: I think spending in Taipei is high, especially rent. Food is okay, though; there are lots of cheap snacks.

records.questionZh: 你週末都會出去玩嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you go out and have fun every weekend?
records.answerZh: 我的時間很有限，週末常常要去上中文課。只能偶爾去附近走走。
records.answerEn: My time is very limited; on weekends I often have Chinese classes. I can only occasionally go somewhere nearby.

records.questionZh: 朋友來台灣玩，你會帶他們去哪裡？
records.questionEn: When friends visit Taiwan, where do you take them?
records.answerZh: 我會帶他們去九份，那裡是很著名的觀光景點。晚上的風景特別漂亮。
records.answerEn: I take them to Jiufen; it's a very famous tourist spot. The view at night is especially beautiful.

records.questionZh: 你理想中的星期天是什麼樣子？
records.questionEn: What does your ideal Sunday look like?
records.answerZh: 我想睡到自然醒，再去吃個早午餐。過一個悠閒的下午。
records.answerEn: I'd like to sleep until I wake up naturally, then go have brunch. And spend a leisurely afternoon.

records.questionZh: 你說想學好中文，有什麼計畫嗎？
records.questionEn: You say you want to get good at Chinese; do you have a plan?
records.answerZh: 我有一個具體的計畫，每天背十個單字。週末再跟語言交換的朋友練習。
records.answerEn: I have a specific plan: memorize ten words every day. Then on weekends I practice with my language exchange partner.

records.questionZh: 你在台灣有看過什麼讓你嚇一跳的大東西嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you seen anything big in Taiwan that startled you?
records.answerZh: 我在台南看過一隻巨大的蟑螂，還會飛。我嚇到尖叫。
records.answerEn: In Tainan I saw a huge cockroach, and it could fly. I was so scared I screamed.

records.questionZh: 認識新朋友的時候，你會主動去聊天嗎？
records.questionEn: When meeting new people, do you take the initiative to chat?
records.answerZh: 我比較被動，通常等別人先來跟我說話。不過聊開了以後我很愛講。
records.answerEn: I'm more passive; I usually wait for others to talk to me first. But once we get talking, I love to chat.

records.questionZh: 在台灣有什麼事是你以前不知道不能做的？
records.questionEn: What's something you didn't know you weren't allowed to do in Taiwan?
records.answerZh: 我不知道在捷運上吃東西是違法的。第一次被提醒的時候很不好意思。
records.answerEn: I didn't know eating on the MRT was against the law. The first time someone reminded me, I was really embarrassed.

records.questionZh: 你有遇過很沒禮貌的人嗎？
records.questionEn: Have you ever met a really impolite person?
records.answerZh: 有一次有人在排隊時直接插隊，還推我一下。我覺得他很粗魯。
records.answerEn: Once someone cut right in line and even pushed me. I thought he was really rude.

records.questionZh: 你收過最讓你感動的禮物是什麼？
records.questionEn: What's the most touching gift you've ever received?
records.answerZh: 我朋友親手做了一本相簿給我。我覺得她真的很用心。
records.answerEn: My friend made me a photo album by hand. I think she really put her heart into it.

records.questionZh: 跟台灣朋友聊天時，有什麼話題你會避開？
records.questionEn: When chatting with Taiwanese friends, are there topics you avoid?
records.answerZh: 我會避開收入和年紀，這些比較敏感。除非很熟才會聊。
records.answerEn: I avoid income and age; those are more sensitive. I only talk about them with people I'm close to.

records.questionZh: 你覺得工作的壓力大嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think your work stress is high?
records.answerZh: 有時候壓力大到我快承受不了。這時候我會跟朋友出去吃宵夜聊聊。
records.answerEn: Sometimes the pressure is so great I can barely bear it. Then I go out for a late-night snack and chat with friends.

records.questionZh: 你說中文的時候，希望別人直接說你哪裡錯嗎？
records.questionEn: When you speak Chinese, do you want people to point out your mistakes directly?
records.answerZh: 我希望大家直接幫我改正錯誤。這樣我才會進步。
records.answerEn: I hope people will correct my mistakes directly. That's the only way I'll improve.

records.questionZh: 你會想自己創業嗎？
records.questionEn: Would you want to start your own business?
records.answerZh: 我有想過，但是風險太大了。我還是先存錢比較實在。
records.answerEn: I've thought about it, but the risk is too big. I think saving money first is more realistic.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有什麼後悔沒做的事？
records.questionEn: Is there anything you regret not doing?
records.answerZh: 我很遺憾小時候沒有好好學鋼琴。現在想學，手指都不靈活了。
records.answerEn: I really regret not learning piano properly as a kid. Now that I want to learn, my fingers aren't nimble anymore.

records.questionZh: 你有沒有跟喜歡的人說出自己的心意過？
records.questionEn: Have you ever told someone you liked how you felt?
records.answerZh: 我高中的時候跟一個女生告白過。結果她說只想當朋友。
records.answerEn: In high school I confessed my feelings to a girl. She said she only wanted to be friends.

records.questionZh: 跟另一半分手以後，你通常怎麼讓自己好起來？
records.questionEn: After breaking up with a partner, how do you usually make yourself feel better?
records.answerZh: 我失戀的時候會找朋友去吃火鍋聊天。大哭一場以後就會好很多。
records.answerEn: When I'm heartbroken, I go eat hot pot and chat with friends. After a good cry I feel much better.

records.questionZh: 你覺得說話直接一點好嗎？
records.questionEn: Do you think being a bit more direct when talking is good?
records.answerZh: 說話直接沒關係，但是不要傷害別人。有些話換個方式說會比較好。
records.answerEn: Being direct is fine, but don't hurt other people. Some things are better said a different way.

records.questionZh: 你覺得台灣的房子跟你國家的有什麼不一樣？
records.questionEn: How do you think houses in Taiwan differ from those in your country?
records.answerZh: 台灣很多房子是鋼筋水泥的結構，比較耐地震。我家鄉的房子大多是木頭的。
records.answerEn: Many houses in Taiwan have a reinforced concrete structure, which holds up better in earthquakes. Houses in my hometown are mostly wooden.
